6.2.3.s: divam ākramiṣam iti yajamāno japati /
6.2.3.d: दिवम् आक्रमिषम् इति यजमानो जपति /
6.2.3.m: The sacrificer mutters: "May I ascend to heaven."

6.2.3.s: vāyavyām uttarām̐ vikarṇīm̐ śarkarāṃ pratiprasthātā prothad aśvo na yavase \\ iti madhye yugapat svayamātṛṇṇālokasyopadadhāti /
6.2.3.d: वायव्याम् उत्तराम्̐ विकर्णीम्̐ शर्करां प्रतिप्रस्थाता प्रोथद् अश्वो न यवसे \\ इति मध्ये युगपत् स्वयमातृण्णालोकस्योपदधाति /
6.2.3.m: The pratiprasthātṛ simultaneously sets down the northern vikarṇī pebble dedicated to Vāyu in the middle of the space of the naturally perforated brick with: "Snorting like a horse in pasture…"

6.2.3.s: vyākhyātam̐ sārvacitikam /
6.2.3.d: व्याख्यातम्̐ सार्वचितिकम् /
6.2.3.m: What applies to every layer has been explained.

6.2.3.s: purīṣeṇa citim̐ sam̐sthāpayaty anyat svayamātṛṇṇāyāḥ /
6.2.3.d: पुरीषेण चितिम्̐ सम्̐स्थापयत्य् अन्यत् स्वयमातृण्णायाः /
6.2.3.m: He completes the layer with loose earth, except for the naturally perforated brick.

6.2.3.s: jānudaghnaṃ prathamaṃ cinvānaś cinvīteti vyākhyātam /
6.2.3.d: जानुदघ्नं प्रथमं चिन्वानश् चिन्वीतेति व्याख्यातम् /
6.2.3.m: The rule: "One piling [the fire-altar] for the first time should pile [it] knee-high" has been explained.

6.2.4.s: sauvarṇānām̐ śakalānām̐ sahasreṇa sahasrasya māsi \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ sarvam agniṃ prokṣya ghṛtena prokṣati vasavas tvā rudraiḥ paścāt pāntu \\ iti paścāt prāṅmukhas \\ nitānas tvā māruto marudbhir uttarataḥ pātu \\ ity uttarato dakṣiṇāmukhas \\ ādityās tvā viśvair devaiḥ purastāt pāntu \\ iti purastāt pratyaṅmukhaḥ pitaras tvā yamarājānaḥ pitṛbhir dakṣiṇataḥ pāntu \\ iti dakṣiṇata udaṅmukhas \\ devās tvendrajyeṣṭhā varuṇarājāno 'dhastāc copariṣṭāc ca pāntu \\ iti madhye prāṅmukhaḥ /
6.2.4.d: सौवर्णानाम्̐ शकलानाम्̐ सहस्रेण सहस्रस्य मासि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः सर्वम् अग्निं प्रोक्ष्य घृतेन प्रोक्षति वसवस् त्वा रुद्रैः पश्चात् पान्तु \\ इति पश्चात् प्राङ्मुखस् \\ नितानस् त्वा मारुतो मरुद्भिर् उत्तरतः पातु \\ इत्य् उत्तरतो दक्षिणामुखस् \\ आदित्यास् त्वा विश्वैर् देवैः पुरस्तात् पान्तु \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुखः पितरस् त्वा यमराजानः पितृभिर् दक्षिणतः पान्तु \\ इति दक्षिणत उदङ्मुखस् \\ देवास् त्वेन्द्रज्येष्ठा वरुणराजानो ऽधस्ताच् चोपरिष्टाच् च पान्तु \\ इति मध्ये प्राङ्मुखः /
6.2.4.m: Having sprinkled the whole fire[-altar] with a thousand gold chips with [the mantras] beginning with "You are the measure of a thousand…", he sprinkles it with clarified butter: facing east from the west with "May the Vasus with the Rudras protect you from the west"; facing south from the north with "May Nitāna, the son of Marut, with the Maruts protect you from the north"; facing west from the east with "May the Ādityas with all the gods protect you from the east"; facing north from the south with "May the Fathers, whose king is Yama, protect you from the south with the Fathers"; facing east in the middle with "May the gods, chief among whom is Indra and whose king is Varuṇa, protect you from below and from above."

6.2.4.s: pratiparikramya \\ imā me agnā iṣṭakā dhenavaḥ santu \\ iti duhenottaraṃ puchāpyayaṃ pratyāramya japati yajamānaḥ /
6.2.4.d: प्रतिपरिक्रम्य \\ इमा मे अग्ना इष्टका धेनवः सन्तु \\ इति दुहेनोत्तरं पुछाप्ययं प्रत्यारम्य जपति यजमानः /
6.2.4.m: Having circumambulated back, touching the northern tail-joint, the sacrificer mutters: "May these bricks be milch cows for me, O Agni…"

6.2.4.s: uttarasyām̐ śroṇāvantyāyām iṣṭakāyām̐ śatarudriyaṃ juhoty arkaparṇenājakṣīraṃ gavīdhukāsaktūn vā namas te rudra manyave \\ itiprabhṛtibhir jānudaghne dhārayamāṇo dakṣiṇāmukhas \\ namo bṛhadbhyo 'rbhakebhyas \\ iti nābhidaghna udaṅmukhas \\ namo vāstavyāya \\ ity āsyadaghne prāṅmukhaḥ /
6.2.4.d: उत्तरस्याम्̐ श्रोणावन्त्यायाम् इष्टकायाम्̐ शतरुद्रियं जुहोत्य् अर्कपर्णेनाजक्षीरं गवीधुकासक्तून् वा नमस् ते रुद्र मन्यवे \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् जानुदघ्ने धारयमाणो दक्षिणामुखस् \\ नमो बृहद्भ्यो ऽर्भकेभ्यस् \\ इति नाभिदघ्न उदङ्मुखस् \\ नमो वास्तव्याय \\ इत्य् आस्यदघ्ने प्राङ्मुखः /
6.2.4.m: On the northern buttock, on the last brick, he offers the Śatarudriya with an arka leaf—goat's milk or groats of gavīdhukā grass—holding [the ladle] at knee-height facing south with [the formulas] beginning with "Homage to your wrath, O Rudra…"; holding it at navel-height facing north with "Homage to the great and to the small…"; holding it at mouth-height facing east with "Homage to him who dwells in the homestead…"

6.2.4.s: pratyavarohāñ juhoti namo astu rudrebhyo ye divi \\ ity āsyādaghna uttareṇa paryāyeṇa nābhidaghna uttamena jānudaghne /
6.2.4.d: प्रत्यवरोहाञ् जुहोति नमो अस्तु रुद्रेभ्यो ये दिवि \\ इत्य् आस्यादघ्न उत्तरेण पर्यायेण नाभिदघ्न उत्तमेन जानुदघ्ने /
6.2.4.m: He offers the descending oblations with "Homage be to the Rudras who are in heaven…" at mouth-height; with the next round at navel-height; with the last at knee-height.

6.2.4.s:
yo rudro 'psu yo 'gnau ya oṣadhīṣu /
yo rudro viśvā bhuvanāviveśa \ tasmai rudrāya namo 'stu devāya //
svāhā \\ iti tasyām iṣṭakāyāṃ gāvīdhukaṃ carum upavapati /
6.2.4.d:
यो रुद्रो ऽप्सु यो ऽग्नौ य ओषधीषु /
यो रुद्रो विश्वा भुवनाविवेश \ तस्मै रुद्राय नमो ऽस्तु देवाय //
स्वाहा \\ इति तस्याम् इष्टकायां गावीधुकं चरुम् उपवपति /
6.2.4.m:
“The Rudra who is in the waters, who is in the fire, who is in the plants,

the Rudra who has entered all beings: / to that divine Rudra be homage!

Svāhā!” On that brick he scatters a boiled oblation of gavidhukā seeds.

6.2.4.s: āyudhaṃ tisṛdhanvam ayācito brāhmaṇāya dadyāt //
6.2.4.d: आयुधं तिसृधन्वम् अयाचितो ब्राह्मणाय दद्यात् //
6.2.4.m: Without being asked, he should give a weapon and a bow with three arrows to a brahmin.

6.2.4.s: aśmann ūrjaṃ parvate śiśriyāṇām ity udakumbhenāgniṃ prasavyaṃ triḥ pariṣiñcan paryeti / nidhāya trir apariṣiñcan pratiparyeti /
6.2.4.d: अश्मन्न् ऊर्जं पर्वते शिश्रियाणाम् इत्य् उदकुम्भेनाग्निं प्रसव्यं त्रिः परिषिञ्चन् पर्येति / निधाय त्रिर् अपरिषिञ्चन् प्रतिपर्येति /
6.2.4.m: With "The strength in the stone that rests in the mountain…", pouring around with a water-jar, he goes around the fire counter-clockwise three times; setting it down, he goes around back three times without pouring around.

6.2.4.s: āgneyapāvamānyām̐ śirasi gāyatraṃ gāyodgātā rathantaraṃ dakṣiṇe pakṣe bṛhad uttarasminn ātmani vāmadevyam̐ yajñāyajñiyaṃ puche prajāpaterhṛdayam anṛcaṃ dakṣiṇasmin nikakṣe stutam̐ hotānuśam̐sati /
6.2.4.d: आग्नेयपावमान्याम्̐ शिरसि गायत्रं गायोद्गाता रथन्तरं दक्षिणे पक्षे बृहद् उत्तरस्मिन्न् आत्मनि वामदेव्यम्̐ यज्ञायज्ञियं पुछे प्रजापतेर्हृदयम् अनृचं दक्षिणस्मिन् निकक्षे स्तुतम्̐ होतानुशम्̐सति /
6.2.4.m: The udgātṛ sings the Gāyatra on an Agni-Pāvamāna verse on the head, the Rathantara on the right wing, the Bṛhat on the left, the Vāmadevya on the body, the Yajñāyajñiya on the tail, the verseless Prajāpatis-Heart on the right armpit; after it is chanted, the hotṛ recites the sastra.

6.2.4.s: parigītaṃ nākrāmed ā svayamātṛṇṇāyā vyāghāraṇāt /
6.2.4.d: परिगीतं नाक्रामेद् आ स्वयमातृण्णाया व्याघारणात् /
6.2.4.m: One should not step onto [the altar] that has been sung over, until the basting of the naturally perforated brick.

6.2.4.s: maṇḍūkenāvakayā vetasaśākhayā ca samudrasya tvāvakayā \ himasya tvā jarāyuṇā \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ saptabhiḥ sarvam agnim̐ vikarṣati /
6.2.4.d: मण्डूकेनावकया वेतसशाखया च समुद्रस्य त्वावकया \ हिमस्य त्वा जरायुणा \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः सप्तभिः सर्वम् अग्निम्̐ विकर्षति /
6.2.4.m: With a frog, an avakā plant, and a reed branch, he drags across the whole fire[-altar] with seven mantras beginning with "With the water-plant of the ocean…" and "With the skin of snow…"

6.2.4.s: vinīya prāṇān maṇḍūkasya vikarṣaṇam utkare pravidhyati / yaṃ dviṣyāt tam etenopahanyāt //
6.2.4.d: विनीय प्राणान् मण्डूकस्य विकर्षणम् उत्करे प्रविध्यति / यं द्विष्यात् तम् एतेनोपहन्यात् //
6.2.4.m: Having removed the breath of the frog, he throws the dragging instrument onto the rubbish heap; him whom he hates, he may strike down with this.

6.2.4.s: iṣṭo yajño bhṛgubhir iti chandasāṃ doham̐ yajamānam̐ vācayati /
6.2.4.d: इष्टो यज्ञो भृगुभिर् इति छन्दसां दोहम्̐ यजमानम्̐ वाचयति /
6.2.4.m: With "The sacrifice was performed by the Bhṛgus…", he has the sacrificer recite the milking of the metres.

6.2.4.s: audumbarīr ghṛte vāsayati /
6.2.4.d: औदुम्बरीर् घृते वासयति /
6.2.4.m: He steeps [sticks of] udumbara wood in clarified butter.

6.2.4.s: āparāhṇikyau pravargyopasadāv upetya vasanti /
6.2.4.d: आपराह्णिक्यौ प्रवर्ग्योपसदाव् उपेत्य वसन्ति /
6.2.4.m: Having performed the afternoon Pravargya and Upasad rites, they dwell [there].

6.2.4.s: ūrdhvaṃ pūrvāhṇikībhyāṃ kṛṣṇājinasyopānahaṃ pratimucya \\ apām idaṃ nyayanam \\ namas te harase śociṣe \\ iti dvābhyām agnim ākrāmati /
6.2.4.d: ऊर्ध्वं पूर्वाह्णिकीभ्यां कृष्णाजिनस्योपानहं प्रतिमुच्य \\ अपाम् इदं न्ययनम् \\ नमस् ते हरसे शोचिषे \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् अग्निम् आक्रामति /
6.2.4.m: After the morning rites, having put on sandals of black antelope skin, he steps onto the fire[-altar] with the two [mantras]: "This is the gathering-place of the waters…" and "Homage to your heat, to your blazing…"

6.2.4.s: pañcagṛhīta ājye hiraṇyaśakalam ekaikam avadhāya druṣade vaḍ \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ svayamātṛṇṇām̐ vyāghārayati yathā nābhim //
6.2.4.d: पञ्चगृहीत आज्ये हिरण्यशकलम् एकैकम् अवधाय द्रुषदे वड् \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः स्वयमातृण्णाम्̐ व्याघारयति यथा नाभिम् //
6.2.4.m: In fivefold-drawn clarified butter, having placed a chip of gold in each, he bastes the naturally perforated brick like a navel with [the formulas] beginning with "To the tree-dweller, vaṭ!"

6.2.4.s: svarvide vaḍ ity ūrdhvām̐ srucam udgṛhṇāti /
6.2.4.d: स्वर्विदे वड् इत्य् ऊर्ध्वाम्̐ स्रुचम् उद्गृह्णाति /
6.2.4.m: With "To the finder of heaven, vaṭ!", he raises the ladle upright.

6.2.4.s: dadhini madhumiśre darbhamuṣṭiṃ paryāsam annapate annasya no dehi \\ iti tisṛbhiḥ sarvam agnim̐ vyavokṣati //
6.2.4.d: दधिनि मधुमिश्रे दर्भमुष्टिं पर्यासम् अन्नपते अन्नस्य नो देहि \\ इति तिसृभिः सर्वम् अग्निम्̐ व्यवोक्षति //
6.2.4.m: Having dipped a handful of darbha grass into curd mixed with honey, he sprinkles all over the fire[-altar] with the three [verses beginning with]: "O Lord of food, give us food…"

6.2.4.s: prāṇadā apāndās \\ iti pratyavarohati /
6.2.4.d: प्राणदा अपान्दास् \\ इति प्रत्यवरोहति /
6.2.4.m: With "Givers of out-breath, givers of in-breath…", he steps down.

6.2.4.s: āparāhṇikīm̐ sadyaḥ sam̐sthāpyotsādya gharmapātrāṇy agnīṣomīyāyaupasadaṃ barhis tad vyākhyātam /
6.2.4.d: आपराह्णिकीम्̐ सद्यः सम्̐स्थाप्योत्साद्य घर्मपात्राण्य् अग्नीषोमीयायौपसदं बर्हिस् तद् व्याख्यातम् /
6.2.4.m: Having immediately concluded the afternoon [Upasad] and having set aside the gharma vessels, the Upasad sacrificial grass for the animal offering to Agni and Soma is used; that has been explained.

6.2.5.s: agnis tigmena śociṣā \\ iti caturgṛhītaṃ juhoti /
6.2.5.d: अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा \\ इति चतुर्गृहीतं जुहोति /
6.2.5.m: With "Agni with sharp blaze…", he offers a fourfold portion.

6.2.5.s: tūṣṇīm̐ ṣoḍaśagṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni \\ ity aṣṭau nigadyārdhaṃ juhoty uttaram anuvākaṃ nigadya śeṣam /
6.2.5.d: तूष्णीम्̐ षोडशगृहीतं गृहीत्वा य इमा विश्वा भुवनानि \\ इत्य् अष्टौ निगद्यार्धं जुहोत्य् उत्तरम् अनुवाकं निगद्य शेषम् /
6.2.5.m: Having silently taken a sixteenfold portion, having uttered the eight [verses beginning with] "He who all these worlds…", he offers half; having uttered the subsequent section, [he offers] the remainder.

6.2.5.s: audumbarīr ghṛtoṣitās tisraḥ samidhas \\ ud enam uttaraṃ naya \\ iti tisṛbhiḥ svāhākārāntābhir ādadhāti /
6.2.5.d: औदुम्बरीर् घृतोषितास् तिस्रः समिधस् \\ उद् एनम् उत्तरं नय \\ इति तिसृभिः स्वाहाकारान्ताभिर् आदधाति /
6.2.5.m: With three verses ending with the call of svāhā, [beginning with] "Lead him higher…", he lays on three kindling sticks of udumbara wood steeped in clarified butter.

6.2.5.s: vyākhyātam agnipraṇayanam //
6.2.5.d: व्याख्यातम् अग्निप्रणयनम् //
6.2.5.m: The carrying forward of the fire has been explained.

6.2.5.s: ud u tvā viśve devās \\ ity agnim ādatte //
6.2.5.d: उद् उ त्वा विश्वे देवास् \\ इत्य् अग्निम् आदत्ते //
6.2.5.m: With "Up, you, all the gods…", he takes up the fire.

6.2.5.s: pañca diśo daivīr yajñam avantu devīr ity uttarataḥ pṛṣṭhyādeśasya ṣaḍbhir āgnīdhrād yanti /
6.2.5.d: पञ्च दिशो दैवीर् यज्ञम् अवन्तु देवीर् इत्य् उत्तरतः पृष्ठ्यादेशस्य षड्भिर् आग्नीध्राद् यन्ति /
6.2.5.m: With the six [verses beginning with] "May the five divine quarters protect the sacrifice, the divine…", they walk from the āgnīdhra fire north of the line of the spine.

6.2.5.s: praṇīyamānasyottarato yajamāno vrajati dakṣiṇato brahmā \\ āśuḥ śiśānas \\ ity apratirathaṃ daśarcam anvāha //
6.2.5.d: प्रणीयमानस्योत्तरतो यजमानो व्रजति दक्षिणतो ब्रह्मा \\ आशुः शिशानस् \\ इत्य् अप्रतिरथं दशर्चम् अन्वाह //
6.2.5.m: The sacrificer walks to the north of [the fire] being carried forward, the brahman priest to the south; he recites along the ten-verse Apratiratha hymn [beginning with] "Swift, sharpening…"

6.2.5.s: vimāna eṣa divo madhya āste \\ iti dvābhyām upadadhāty āgnīdhrīye 'śmānam upadhānavelāyām //
6.2.5.d: विमान एष दिवो मध्य आस्ते \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् उपदधात्य् आग्नीध्रीये ऽश्मानम् उपधानवेलायाम् //
6.2.5.m: At the time of placing the stone, he sets it down in the āgnīdhra fire with two verses: "This measurer sits in the middle of heaven…"

6.2.5.s: sumnahūr yajña ā ca vakṣad iti caturbhir āhavanīyād yanti //
6.2.5.d: सुम्नहूर् यज्ञ आ च वक्षद् इति चतुर्भिर् आहवनीयाद् यन्ति //
6.2.5.m: With the four [verses beginning with] "Calling for benevolence, may he bring the sacrifice…", they walk from the āhavanīya fire.

6.2.5.s: kramadhvam agninā \\ iti pañcabhir agnim ākrāmati /
6.2.5.d: क्रमध्वम् अग्निना \\ इति पञ्चभिर् अग्निम् आक्रामति /
6.2.5.m: With the five [formulas beginning with] "Stride along with Agni…", he steps onto the fire[-altar].

6.2.5.s: kṛṣṇāyāḥ śvetavatsāyāḥ payasaḥ pūrṇām audumbarīṃ naktoṣāsā \\ agne sahasrākṣa \\ iti nigadya svayamātṛṇṇām abhijuhoti /
6.2.5.d: कृष्णायाः श्वेतवत्सायाः पयसः पूर्णाम् औदुम्बरीं नक्तोषासा \\ अग्ने सहस्राक्ष \\ इति निगद्य स्वयमातृण्णाम् अभिजुहोति /
6.2.5.m: Having recited [the two mantras] "Night and Dawn…" and "O Agni of a thousand eyes…", he pours an offering of an udumbara vessel filled with the milk of a black cow with a white calf over the naturally perforated brick.

6.2.5.s: tasyām̐ saṃbhārān hiraṇyaśakalaṃ ca nyupya suparṇo 'si garutmān \ pṛṣṭhe pṛthivyāḥ sīda \ ājuhvānaḥ supratīkas \\ iti dvābhyām agnim̐ sādayitvā samidhya samidha ādadhāti tām̐ savitur vareṇyasya \\ iti śamīmayīm \\ vidhema te parame janmann agne \\ ity āśvatthīm \\ preddho agne \\ iti vaikaṅkatīm //
6.2.5.d: तस्याम्̐ संभारान् हिरण्यशकलं च न्युप्य सुपर्णो ऽसि गरुत्मान् \ पृष्ठे पृथिव्याः सीद \ आजुह्वानः सुप्रतीकस् \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् अग्निम्̐ सादयित्वा समिध्य समिध आदधाति ताम्̐ सवितुर् वरेण्यस्य \\ इति शमीमयीम् \\ विधेम ते परमे जन्मन्न् अग्ने \\ इत्य् आश्वत्थीम् \\ प्रेद्धो अग्ने \\ इति वैकङ्कतीम् //
6.2.5.m: Having strewn the materials and the piece of gold on it, having set down the fire with the two [formulas], "You are the eagle, winged... settle on the back of the earth" and "Being invoked, fair-faced...", and having kindled it, he places the kindling sticks: one of śamī wood with "That of the creator, of the most excellent...", one of aśvattha wood with "May we honor you, Agni, in your highest birth...", and one of vikaṅkata wood with "Agni, being brightly kindled...".

6.2.5.s: agne tam adya \\ iti paṅktyā juhoti sapta te agne samidhas \\ iti pūrṇāhutim \\ citiṃ juhomi \\ ity anuvākaśeṣeṇa dvitīyām /
6.2.5.d: अग्ने तम् अद्य \\ इति पङ्क्त्या जुहोति सप्त ते अग्ने समिधस् \\ इति पूर्णाहुतिम् \\ चितिं जुहोमि \\ इत्य् अनुवाकशेषेण द्वितीयाम् /
6.2.5.m: He offers with the paṅkti [verse], "Agni, him today..."; the full-spoon offering with "Seven are your kindling sticks, Agni..."; and the second with the remainder of the section, "I offer the layer...".

6.2.5.s: agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet /
6.2.5.d: अग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालं निर्वपेत् /
6.2.5.m: He should apportion [the grain] for a twelve-potsherd [cake] to Agni Vaiśvānara.

6.2.5.s: sruvaṃ juhūṃ ca saṃmṛjyābhyudāharati vaiśvānarīyam /
6.2.5.d: स्रुवं जुहूं च संमृज्याभ्युदाहरति वैश्वानरीयम् /
6.2.5.m: Having wiped the sruva and the juhū, he brings forward the Vaiśvānara [cake].

6.2.5.s: sakṛt sarvam avadyati /
6.2.5.d: सकृत् सर्वम् अवद्यति /

6.2.5.s: āśayasyānvāsicya dvir abhighāryopām̐śu \\ agnaye vaiśvānarāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
6.2.5.d: आशयस्यान्वासिच्य द्विर् अभिघार्योपाम्̐शु \\ अग्नये वैश्वानरायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
6.2.5.m: Having poured [clarified butter] after it from the receptacle and basted it twice with clarified butter, he makes [the hotṛ] recite the invitatory verse in a whisper with "Recite for Agni Vaiśvānara".

6.2.5.s: āśrāvya \\ agnim̐ vaiśnānaram̐ yaja \\ iti preṣyati /
6.2.5.d: आश्राव्य \\ अग्निम्̐ वैश्नानरम्̐ यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
6.2.5.m: Having caused [the āgnīdhra] to respond, he issues the call: "Offer to Agni Vaiśvānara!"

6.2.5.s: vaṣaṭkṛte madhye pāṇinā juhoti /
6.2.5.d: वषट्कृते मध्ये पाणिना जुहोति /
6.2.5.m: When the vaṣaṭ is uttered, he offers it with his hand in the middle [of the fire].

6.2.5.s: ṛjuṃ pratiṣṭhitam āśayenābhijuhoti /
6.2.5.d: ऋजुं प्रतिष्ठितम् आशयेनाभिजुहोति /
6.2.5.m: Upon it, straight and firmly placed, he pours an oblation from the receptacle.

6.2.5.s: yadi paryāvarteta brāhmaṇavyākhyātam /
6.2.5.d: यदि पर्यावर्तेत ब्राह्मणव्याख्यातम् /
6.2.5.m: If it should turn over, the explanation is given in the Brāhmaṇa.

6.2.5.s: puroḍāśān sapta saptakapālān tūṣṇīm upacaritān sam̐skaroti /
6.2.5.d: पुरोडाशान् सप्त सप्तकपालान् तूष्णीम् उपचरितान् सम्̐स्करोति /
6.2.5.m: He prepares seven seven-potsherd cakes treated silently.

6.2.5.s: upastaraṇābhighāraṇaiḥ saṃpātaṃ mārutair gaṇair juhoti śukrajyotiś ca citrajyotiś ca \\ itiprabhṛtibhir dakṣiṇārdhe pūrvārdhe \\ ṛtajic ca satyajic ca \\ iti dakṣiṇārdhe \\ ṛtaś ca satyaś ca \\ iti dakṣiṇārdhe paścārdhe 'raṇye 'dhītena gaṇena paścārdhe \\ īdṛṅ caitādṛṅ ca \\ ity uttarārdhe paścārdhe \\ īdṛkṣāsa etādṛkṣāsas \\ ity uttarārdhe sabharaso maruto yajñe \\ ity uttarārdhe pūrvārdhe /
6.2.5.d: उपस्तरणाभिघारणैः संपातं मारुतैर् गणैर् जुहोति शुक्रज्योतिश् च चित्रज्योतिश् च \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् दक्षिणार्धे पूर्वार्धे \\ ऋतजिच् च सत्यजिच् च \\ इति दक्षिणार्धे \\ ऋतश् च सत्यश् च \\ इति दक्षिणार्धे पश्चार्धे ऽरण्ये ऽधीतेन गणेन पश्चार्धे \\ ईदृङ् चैतादृङ् च \\ इत्य् उत्तरार्धे पश्चार्धे \\ ईदृक्षास एतादृक्षासस् \\ इत्य् उत्तरार्धे सभरसो मरुतो यज्ञे \\ इत्य् उत्तरार्धे पूर्वार्धे /
6.2.5.m: With the under-spreadings and bastings, he offers the residue along with the groups of the Maruts: in the eastern half of the southern half with the formulas beginning with "Śukrajyotis and Citrajyotis..."; in the southern half with "Ṛtajit and Satyajit..."; in the western half of the southern half with "Ṛta and Satya..."; in the western half with the group learned in the forest; in the western half of the northern half with "Īdṛś and Etādṛś..."; in the northern half with "Īdṛkṣas and Etādṛkṣas..."; and in the eastern half of the northern half with "The energetic Maruts at the sacrifice...".

6.2.5.s: vasordhārāyai srucam audumbarīṃ mahatīm̐ syonadaṇḍāṃ kārayed yathā vaiśvānarīye dhārā pratiṣṭhāsyati tathāvasthāpayet /
6.2.5.d: वसोर्धारायै स्रुचम् औदुम्बरीं महतीम्̐ स्योनदण्डां कारयेद् यथा वैश्वानरीये धारा प्रतिष्ठास्यति तथावस्थापयेत् /
6.2.5.m: He should have a large sruc made of udumbara wood with a comfortable handle for the shower of wealth (vasordhārā); he should position it so that the stream will stand steady upon the Vaiśvānara [offering].

6.2.5.s: tūṣṇīṃ dvādaśāni gṛhītvānvārabdhe yajamāne vācayan vājaś ca me prasavaś ca me \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ pañcabhir anuvākaiḥ saṃtatam̐ vasordhārāṃ juhoti //
6.2.5.d: तूष्णीं द्वादशानि गृहीत्वान्वारब्धे यजमाने वाचयन् वाजश् च मे प्रसवश् च मे \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः पञ्चभिर् अनुवाकैः संततम्̐ वसोर्धारां जुहोति //
6.2.5.m: Having taken twelve [ladlefuls] silently, with the sacrificer touching him from behind and while making [the sacrificer] recite, he offers the continuous shower of wealth with the five sections beginning with "And my vigour, and my impulse...".

6.2.5.s: ekā ca tisraś ca \\ ity ā trayastrim̐śataś catasraś cāṣṭau ca \\ ity aṣṭācatvārim̐śatas tryaviś ca tryavī ca \\ iti yathāmnātam \\ dhenuś cānaḍvām̐ś ca \\ āyur yajñena kalpate \ prāṇo yajñena kalpate \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ pataye 'dhipataye \\ ity antena stomaś ca yajuś ca \\ iti yathāmnātam antataḥ svāhākāraṃ kuryāt /
6.2.5.d: एका च तिस्रश् च \\ इत्य् आ त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शतश् चतस्रश् चाष्टौ च \\ इत्य् अष्टाचत्वारिम्̐शतस् त्र्यविश् च त्र्यवी च \\ इति यथाम्नातम् \\ धेनुश् चानड्वाम्̐श् च \\ आयुर् यज्ञेन कल्पते \ प्राणो यज्ञेन कल्पते \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः पतये ऽधिपतये \\ इत्य् अन्तेन स्तोमश् च यजुश् च \\ इति यथाम्नातम् अन्ततः स्वाहाकारं कुर्यात् /
6.2.5.m: With "And one and three..." up to thirty-three; with "And four and eight..." up to forty-eight; with "And the three-year-old bull and three-year-old cow..." as recited; with "And the milch cow and the draft-ox..."; with the formulas beginning with "May life succeed through sacrifice, may breath succeed through sacrifice..." ending with "To the master, to the overlord"; and with "And the stoma and the yajus..." as recited—he should pronounce svāhā at the end.

6.2.5.s: srucam anuprahṛtyājyātśeṣe catuḥśarāvaṃ jīvataṇḍulam odanaṃ paktvā madhyataḥkāribhyo dadyāt tebhyaś catasraścatasro dhenūḥ /
6.2.5.d: स्रुचम् अनुप्रहृत्याज्यात्शेषे चतुःशरावं जीवतण्डुलम् ओदनं पक्त्वा मध्यतःकारिभ्यो दद्यात् तेभ्यश् चतस्रश्चतस्रो धेनूः /
6.2.5.m: Having thrown the sruc [into the fire] after [the offering], having cooked a four-śarāva mess of boiled rice from unbroken grains in the residue of the clarified butter, he should give it to the central officiating priests, and to each of them four milch cows.

6.2.5.s: oṣadhīr āraṇyā grāmyāś ca sarpiṣā sam̐sṛjya vājaprasavyam audumbareṇa sruveṇa juhoti \\ agne achā vadeha nas \\ ity aṣṭābhir viśve no adya marutas \\ iti ṣaḍbhiḥ /
6.2.5.d: ओषधीर् आरण्या ग्राम्याश् च सर्पिषा सम्̐सृज्य वाजप्रसव्यम् औदुम्बरेण स्रुवेण जुहोति \\ अग्ने अछा वदेह नस् \\ इत्य् अष्टाभिर् विश्वे नो अद्य मरुतस् \\ इति षड्भिः /
6.2.5.m: Having mixed wild and cultivated herbs with clarified butter, he offers the vājaprasavya oblations with an udumbara sruva with the eight verses, "Agni, speak hither to us...", and the six verses, "May all the Maruts today [favor] us...".

6.2.5.s: hutvāhutvā pātryām̐ saṃpātam avanayati /
6.2.5.d: हुत्वाहुत्वा पात्र्याम्̐ संपातम् अवनयति /
6.2.5.m: After each offering, he pours the residue into a vessel.

6.2.5.s: dakṣiṇasyāḥ śroṇeḥ paścād agnipuchasya vāsandyāṃ kṛṣṇājinam āstīrya bastājinaṃ paśrukāmasya tasyām āsīnaṃ devasya tvā savituḥ prasave \\ iti saṃpātenābhiṣiñcati /
6.2.5.d: दक्षिणस्याः श्रोणेः पश्चाद् अग्निपुछस्य वासन्द्यां कृष्णाजिनम् आस्तीर्य बस्ताजिनं पश्रुकामस्य तस्याम् आसीनं देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इति संपातेनाभिषिञ्चति /
6.2.5.m: Behind the right hip [or] behind the tail of the fire-altar, having spread a black antelope skin on a wicker seat—a goat skin for one desirous of livestock—he sprinkles him seated upon it with the residue [of the butter] with "At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ...".

6.2.5.s: śiraso 'dhy ā mukhād avasrāvayati bṛhaspatim̐ sāmrājyāya \\ iti brāhmaṇam indram̐ sāmrājyāya \\ iti rājanyam agnim̐ sāmrājyāya \\ iti vaiśyaṃ / na vābhiṣiñced vaiśyam /
6.2.5.d: शिरसो ऽध्य् आ मुखाद् अवस्रावयति बृहस्पतिम्̐ साम्राज्याय \\ इति ब्राह्मणम् इन्द्रम्̐ साम्राज्याय \\ इति राजन्यम् अग्निम्̐ साम्राज्याय \\ इति वैश्यं / न वाभिषिञ्चेद् वैश्यम् /
6.2.5.m: From the head down over his face, he lets it flow down, [saying] "Bṛhaspati for imperial rule" in the case of a brāhmaṇa, "Indra for imperial rule" in the case of a rājanya, [and] "Agni for imperial rule" in the case of a vaiśya; or he should not sprinkle a vaiśya.

6.2.5.s: dvādaśagṛhītena dvādaśa rāṣṭrabhṛto juhoti \\ ṛtāṣāḍ ṛtadhāmā \\ itiprabhṛtayaḥ paryāyās teṣām ekaikena paryāyeṇāhutī dvedve tasmai svāhā vaḍ iti pūrvām \\ tābhyaḥ svāhā vaḍ ity uttarām \\ sa na idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati tā nā idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pāntu \\ iti ca // bṛhaspatir viśvakarmā \\ iti dvādaśo brāhmaṇasya prajāpatiḥ parameṣṭhī \\ iti rājanyasya \\ amṛḍayo dūrehetir iti vaiśyasya /
6.2.5.d: द्वादशगृहीतेन द्वादश राष्ट्रभृतो जुहोति \\ ऋताषाड् ऋतधामा \\ इतिप्रभृतयः पर्यायास् तेषाम् एकैकेन पर्यायेणाहुती द्वेद्वे तस्मै स्वाहा वड् इति पूर्वाम् \\ ताभ्यः स्वाहा वड् इत्य् उत्तराम् \\ स न इदं ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पातु \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति ता ना इदं ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पान्तु \\ इति च // बृहस्पतिर् विश्वकर्मा \\ इति द्वादशो ब्राह्मणस्य प्रजापतिः परमेष्ठी \\ इति राजन्यस्य \\ अमृडयो दूरेहेतिर् इति वैश्यस्य /
6.2.5.m: With twelve ladlefuls, he offers twelve realm-sustaining oblations (rāṣṭrabhṛts); the turns begin with "Victor by truth, whose abode is truth..."; with each single turn of these [formulas he makes] two oblations: the former with "To him svāhā, vaṭ!", the latter with "To them svāhā, vaṭ!"; everywhere he subjoins "May he protect this our brahman and kṣatra!" and "May they protect this our brahman and kṣatra!"; "Bṛhaspati Viśvakarman" is the twelfth in the case of a brāhmaṇa, "Prajāpati Parameṣṭhin" in the case of a rājanya, and "Amṛḍaya Dūreheti" in the case of a vaiśya.

6.2.5.s: dvirgṛhītena sa no bhuvanasya pate \\ iti rathaśirasy adhy āhavanīye hutvā tam adhvaryave dakṣiṇākāle dadyāt //
6.2.5.d: द्विर्गृहीतेन स नो भुवनस्य पते \\ इति रथशिरस्य् अध्य् आहवनीये हुत्वा तम् अध्वर्यवे दक्षिणाकाले दद्यात् //
6.2.5.m: With two ladlefuls taken, having offered upon the āhavanīya at the chariot-head with "May he, the lord of the world...", he should give it to the adhvaryu at the time of the sacrificial gifts.

6.2.5.s: samudro 'si nabhasvān ārdradānur itiprabhṛtibhir añjalinā trir vātaṃ juhoti kṛṣṇājinapuṭena vā /
6.2.5.d: समुद्रो ऽसि नभस्वान् आर्द्रदानुर् इतिप्रभृतिभिर् अञ्जलिना त्रिर् वातं जुहोति कृष्णाजिनपुटेन वा /
6.2.5.m: With his cupped hands, or with a fold of the black antelope skin, he offers wind three times with the formulas beginning with "You are the ocean, misty, rainy...".

6.2.6.s: padalobhanaprabhṛti siddham ā dhiṣṇyanivapanāt /
6.2.6.d: पदलोभनप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ धिष्ण्यनिवपनात् /
6.2.6.m: From the leading of the foot [of the cow] onwards, [the ritual] is established up to the strewing of the dhiṣṇya hearths.

6.2.6.s: vaihavībhir dhiṣṇyeṣūpadadhāty aśmanavamā āgnīdhra ekavim̐śatim̐ hotrya ekādaśa brāhmaṇācham̐sye 'ṣṭāṣṭā itareṣu ṣaṇ mārjālīye paśuśrapaṇe ca /
6.2.6.d: वैहवीभिर् धिष्ण्येषूपदधात्य् अश्मनवमा आग्नीध्र एकविम्̐शतिम्̐ होत्र्य एकादश ब्राह्मणाछम्̐स्ये ऽष्टाष्टा इतरेषु षण् मार्जालीये पशुश्रपणे च /
6.2.6.m: With the vaihavī verses he sets [the bricks] on the dhiṣṇya hearths: twenty-one, with the stone as the ninth, on the āgnīdhra hearth; eleven on the hotṛ's hearth; eight on the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin's; eight each on the others; six on the mārjālīya; and [six] on the hearth for cooking the victim.

6.2.6.s: siddham āgnīṣomīyāt /
6.2.6.d: सिद्धम् आग्नीषोमीयात् /

6.2.6.s: agnaye gāyatrāya trivṛte rāthantarāyeti daśahaviṣam̐ sarvapṛṣṭhām agnīṣomīyasya paśupuroḍāśam anunirvapati /
6.2.6.d: अग्नये गायत्राय त्रिवृते राथन्तरायेति दशहविषम्̐ सर्वपृष्ठाम् अग्नीषोमीयस्य पशुपुरोडाशम् अनुनिर्वपति /
6.2.6.m: Along with the victim-cake of the Agni-Soma victim, he apportions an all-pṛṣṭha oblation consisting of ten oblations, beginning with "To Agni associated with the Gāyatrī, the threefold, the Rathantara...".

6.2.6.s: yathā devikāhavirbhis tathā pracarati /
6.2.6.d: यथा देविकाहविर्भिस् तथा प्रचरति /
6.2.6.m: He proceeds in the same manner as with the Devikā oblations.

6.2.6.s: siddha upavasathaḥ /
6.2.6.d: सिद्ध उपवसथः /

6.2.6.s: śvobhūte 'gniṣṭoma ukthyo 'tirātro vā /
6.2.6.d: श्वोभूते ऽग्निष्टोम उक्थ्यो ऽतिरात्रो वा /
6.2.6.m: On the next day, there is an Agniṣṭoma, an Ukthya, or an Atirātra.

6.2.6.s: siddham ā paridhīnāṃ paridhānāt /
6.2.6.d: सिद्धम् आ परिधीनां परिधानात् /
6.2.6.m: [The ritual] is established up to the placing of the enclosing sticks.

6.2.6.s: āghārasamidham ādhāya \\ agnim̐ yunajmi śavasā ghṛtena \\ ity agniyogaṃ juhoti //
6.2.6.d: आघारसमिधम् आधाय \\ अग्निम्̐ युनज्मि शवसा घृतेन \\ इत्य् अग्नियोगं जुहोति //
6.2.6.m: Having placed the kindling stick of the libation, he offers the yoking of the fire with "I yoke Agni with strength, with clarified butter...".

6.2.6.s: imau te pakṣau \\ indur dakṣas \\ iti pakṣāv abhimṛśati //
6.2.6.d: इमौ ते पक्षौ \\ इन्दुर् दक्षस् \\ इति पक्षाव् अभिमृशति //
6.2.6.m: With "These two wings of yours..." and "Indu, clever...", he touches the two wings.

6.2.6.s: svayaṃ kṛṇvānas \\ iti pañcabhir anvārohāñ juhoti /
6.2.6.d: स्वयं कृण्वानस् \\ इति पञ्चभिर् अन्वारोहाञ् जुहोति /
6.2.6.m: With the five verses, "Creating by oneself...", he offers the ascending oblations (anvārohas).

6.2.6.s: ekayūpa ekādaśinān upākaroti kratupaśūn vā /
6.2.6.d: एकयूप एकादशिनान् उपाकरोति क्रतुपशून् वा /
6.2.6.m: At a single sacrificial post, he brings forward the eleven victims or the sacrifice-victims.

6.2.6.s: siddham ā dakṣiṇākālāt /
6.2.6.d: सिद्धम् आ दक्षिणाकालात् /
6.2.6.m: [The ritual] is established up to the time of the sacrificial gifts.

6.2.6.s: sauvarṇam̐ śatamānam̐ sthālaṃ madhunaḥ pūrṇaṃ dakṣiṇābhiḥ sahātihṛtya citraṃ devānām iti yajamāno 'vekṣya brahmaṇe prayachati /
6.2.6.d: सौवर्णम्̐ शतमानम्̐ स्थालं मधुनः पूर्णं दक्षिणाभिः सहातिहृत्य चित्रं देवानाम् इति यजमानो ऽवेक्ष्य ब्रह्मणे प्रयछति /
6.2.6.m: Having brought across a golden vessel weighing a hundred mānas filled with honey along with the sacrificial gifts, the sacrificer, having looked at it with "The wonderful [face] of the gods...", gives it to the brahman.

6.2.6.s: siddham āgniṣṭomacamasebhyaḥ /
6.2.6.d: सिद्धम् आग्निष्टोमचमसेभ्यः /
6.2.6.m: [The ritual] is established up to the Agniṣṭoma cups.

6.2.6.s: agniṣṭomacamasān unnīya divo mūrdhāsi \\ ity apsumatībhyām agnim̐ saṃmṛśati /
6.2.6.d: अग्निष्टोमचमसान् उन्नीय दिवो मूर्धासि \\ इत्य् अप्सुमतीभ्याम् अग्निम्̐ संमृशति /
6.2.6.m: Having drawn the Agniṣṭoma cups, he touches the fire with the two water-bearing verses: "You are the head of heaven...".

6.2.6.s: siddham ā śam̐yor vākāt //
6.2.6.d: सिद्धम् आ शम्̐योर् वाकात् //

6.2.6.s: vi te muñcāmi raśanām̐ vi raśmīn iti paridhivimokaṃ japati /
6.2.6.d: वि ते मुञ्चामि रशनाम्̐ वि रश्मीन् इति परिधिविमोकं जपति /
6.2.6.m: He mutters the unloosening of the enclosing sticks with "I unloose your cord, your rays...".

6.2.6.s:
śam̐yvante sam̐sthite
imam̐ stanaṃ madhumantaṃ dhayāpām̐ \ prapīnam agne salilasya madhye /
utsaṃ juṣasva madhumantam ūrmim\ samudriyam̐ salilam ā viśasva //
ity agnivimokaṃ japati /
6.2.6.d:
शम्̐य्वन्ते सम्̐स्थिते
इमम्̐ स्तनं मधुमन्तं धयापाम्̐ \ प्रपीनम् अग्ने सलिलस्य मध्ये /
उत्सं जुषस्व मधुमन्तम् ऊर्मिम्\ समुद्रियम्̐ सलिलम् आ विशस्व //
इत्य् अग्निविमोकं जपति /

6.2.6.s: siddham ānūbandhyāyāḥ /
6.2.6.d: सिद्धम् आनूबन्ध्यायाः /
6.2.6.m: [The ritual] is established up to the anūbandhyā cow.

6.2.6.s: prāk samiṣṭayajurbhyas \\ yās te agne sūrye rucas \\ yā vo devāḥ sūrye rucas \\ rucaṃ no dhehi \\ iti srucaṃ juhoti //
6.2.6.d: प्राक् समिष्टयजुर्भ्यस् \\ यास् ते अग्ने सूर्ये रुचस् \\ या वो देवाः सूर्ये रुचस् \\ रुचं नो धेहि \\ इति स्रुचं जुहोति //
6.2.6.m: Before the samiṣṭayajus formulas, he offers a ladleful with "Whatever splendors of yours, Agni, are in the sun...", "Whatever splendors of yours, gods, are in the sun...", [and] "Bestow splendor upon us!".

6.2.6.s: tat tvā yāmi \\ iti vāruṇyā prāg vediparyoṣaṇād dadhighṛte sam̐sṛjya samīcī nāmāsi \\ iti paryāyair abhijuhoti pratidiśaṃ dvābhyāṃ madhye /
6.2.6.d: तत् त्वा यामि \\ इति वारुण्या प्राग् वेदिपर्योषणाद् दधिघृते सम्̐सृज्य समीची नामासि \\ इति पर्यायैर् अभिजुहोति प्रतिदिशं द्वाभ्यां मध्ये /
6.2.6.m: With the verse addressed to Varuṇa: "That I ask of you...", before the scorching of the altar, having mixed curd and clarified butter, he offers additional oblations with the formulas: "Samīcī is your name...", in each direction, and with two in the middle.

6.2.6.s: sam̐sthāpyodavasānīyāṃ dīkṣayā tvāpam \\ tapasā tvāpam \\ sutyayā tvāpam \ avabhṛthena tvāpam \\ vaśayā tvāpam iti prayāsyann āptibhir aiṣṭakam agnim upatiṣṭhate /
6.2.6.d: सम्̐स्थाप्योदवसानीयां दीक्षया त्वापम् \\ तपसा त्वापम् \\ सुत्यया त्वापम् \ अवभृथेन त्वापम् \\ वशया त्वापम् इति प्रयास्यन्न् आप्तिभिर् ऐष्टकम् अग्निम् उपतिष्ठते /
6.2.6.m: Having concluded the udavasānīyā offering, about to set out, he approaches the brick-built fire with the obtaining formulas: "Through consecration I obtained you; through ascetic heat I obtained you; through pressing I obtained you; through the final bath I obtained you; through the barren cow I obtained you."

6.2.6.s: agnicit sam̐vatsaraṃ na pratyavarohen na pratyuttiṣṭhed yāvajjīvam̐ varṣati na dhāvet pakṣiṇaḥ śiraso nāśnīyān na rāmām upeyād dvitīyaṃ citvā nānyasya bhāryāṃ tṛtīyaṃ citvā na kāṃcana / yady upeyān maitrāvaruṇyāmikṣayā yajeta /
6.2.6.d: अग्निचित् सम्̐वत्सरं न प्रत्यवरोहेन् न प्रत्युत्तिष्ठेद् यावज्जीवम्̐ वर्षति न धावेत् पक्षिणः शिरसो नाश्नीयान् न रामाम् उपेयाद् द्वितीयं चित्वा नान्यस्य भार्यां तृतीयं चित्वा न कांचन / यद्य् उपेयान् मैत्रावरुण्यामिक्षया यजेत /
6.2.6.m: One who has piled the fire should not descend [from a carriage] or rise up to meet [anyone] for a year; for the rest of his life, he should not run while it rains; he should not eat from the head of a bird; he should not approach a low-caste woman; having piled it a second time, [he should] not [approach] the wife of another; having piled it a third time, [he should approach] no woman at all. If he approaches [one], he should sacrifice with a curd offering to Mitra and Varuṇa.

6.2.6.s:
ye agnayaḥ purīṣiṇas\ āviṣṭāḥ pṛthivīm anu /
teṣām asi tvam uttamaḥ \ pra no jīvātave suva //
iti pravāsād etyaiṣṭakam agnim upatiṣṭhate \\ upa tvāgne divedive \\ iti tṛcenānyeṣām /
6.2.6.d:
ये अग्नयः पुरीषिणस्\ आविष्टाः पृथिवीम् अनु /
तेषाम् असि त्वम् उत्तमः \ प्र नो जीवातवे सुव //
इति प्रवासाद् एत्यैष्टकम् अग्निम् उपतिष्ठते \\ उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे \\ इति तृचेनान्येषाम् /
6.2.6.m:
"The fires consisting of loose soil, / which have entered throughout the earth,

Of them you are the highest; / impel us toward living!"

Having returned from a journey, he approaches the brick-built fire with this [formula]; [the fire] of other [types] with the triplet: "To you, O Agni, day by day...".

6.2.6.s: agniṃ citvaiṣṭikyā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta /
6.2.6.d: अग्निं चित्वैष्टिक्या सौत्रामण्या यजेत /
6.2.6.m: Having piled the fire, he should sacrifice with an offering-style Sautrāmaṇī.

6.2.6.s: punaścitis tisraś citayaḥ //
6.2.6.d: पुनश्चितिस् तिस्रश् चितयः //
6.2.6.m: The re-piling consists of three layers.

6.2.6.s: yena ṛṣayas tapasā satram āsata \\ ity aṣṭau nānāyajuṣa upādhāyāṣṭau lokaṃpṛṇāḥ purīṣeṇa citim̐ saṃchādayaty ekādaśa dvitīyasyāṃ dvādaśa tṛtīyasyām /
6.2.6.d: येन ऋषयस् तपसा सत्रम् आसत \\ इत्य् अष्टौ नानायजुष उपाधायाष्टौ लोकंपृणाः पुरीषेण चितिम्̐ संछादयत्य् एकादश द्वितीयस्यां द्वादश तृतीयस्याम् /
6.2.6.m: Having laid down eight bricks with distinct formulas with: "By means of the ascetic heat through which the seers sat at the sacrificial session...", [and] eight space-filling bricks, he covers the layer with loose soil; eleven on the second; twelve on the third.

6.2.6.s: somena yajamāna ṛddhikāmaḥ purā cite punaścitiṃ cinvīta citvā vā vyāghāramāṇo vyāghāritāyām uttaravedau /
6.2.6.d: सोमेन यजमान ऋद्धिकामः पुरा चिते पुनश्चितिं चिन्वीत चित्वा वा व्याघारमाणो व्याघारितायाम् उत्तरवेदौ /
6.2.6.m: Sacrificing with Soma, one desiring prosperity should pile the re-piling on a previously piled [fire], or having piled it, anointing [the altar], on the anointed high altar.

6.2.6.s: yeṣv agnir na saṃbhavet teṣu punaścitim ayam̐ so agnir ity aṣṭau nānāyajuṣas trayodaśa lokaṃpṛṇās tā ekavim̐śatiḥ //
6.2.6.d: येष्व् अग्निर् न संभवेत् तेषु पुनश्चितिम् अयम्̐ सो अग्निर् इत्य् अष्टौ नानायजुषस् त्रयोदश लोकंपृणास् ता एकविम्̐शतिः //
6.2.6.m: On those [layers] where fire does not take place, the re-piling [is done]; with: "This is that Agni...", there are eight [bricks] with distinct formulas and thirteen space-filling bricks; they are twenty-one.

6.2.6.s: ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyas \\ ity agniṃ nidadhāti nidadhāti /
6.2.6.d: अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियस् \\ इत्य् अग्निं निदधाति निदधाति /
6.2.6.m: He sets down the fire with: "This is your seasonal womb...", he sets it down.

7.1.1.s: śaradi vājapeyena yajeta svārājyakāmo brāhmaṇo rājanyo vā /
7.1.1.d: शरदि वाजपेयेन यजेत स्वाराज्यकामो ब्राह्मणो राजन्यो वा /
7.1.1.m: In autumn, a Brahmin or a kṣatriya desiring universal sovereignty should sacrifice with the Vājapeya.

7.1.1.s: saptadaśa dīkṣās tirsa upasadaḥ /
7.1.1.d: सप्तदश दीक्षास् तिर्स उपसदः /
7.1.1.m: There are seventeen consecrations and three upasad days.

7.1.1.s: surām̐ saṃdhāpayet pariśrite /
7.1.1.d: सुराम्̐ संधापयेत् परिश्रिते /
7.1.1.m: He should have liquor brewed inside an enclosure.

7.1.1.s: siddham ā kharakaraṇāt /
7.1.1.d: सिद्धम् आ खरकरणात् /
7.1.1.m: The procedure is established up to the construction of the mound.

7.1.1.s: dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya paścād akṣaṃ pratiprasthātā dvitīyaṃ kharaṃ karoti samutkhātam āhārya purīṣam /
7.1.1.d: दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य पश्चाद् अक्षं प्रतिप्रस्थाता द्वितीयं खरं करोति समुत्खातम् आहार्य पुरीषम् /
7.1.1.m: Behind the axle of the southern cart-shed, the pratiprasthātṛ makes a second mound, having brought up loose soil dug up [from elsewhere].

7.1.1.s: siddham ā takṣaṇāt /
7.1.1.d: सिद्धम् आ तक्षणात् /

7.1.1.s: khādiraś caturasraḥ saptadaśāratnir yūpo godhūmapiṣṭānāṃ caṣālam /
7.1.1.d: खादिरश् चतुरस्रः सप्तदशारत्निर् यूपो गोधूमपिष्टानां चषालम् /
7.1.1.m: The sacrificial post is of khadira wood, four-cornered, seventeen cubits long; and the top-ring is made of wheat dough.

7.1.1.s: nordhvaṃ caṣālād atirecayati /
7.1.1.d: नोर्ध्वं चषालाद् अतिरेचयति /
7.1.1.m: He does not let it project upward beyond the top-ring.

7.1.1.s: siddham ā raśanākālāt /
7.1.1.d: सिद्धम् आ रशनाकालात् /

7.1.1.s: raśanāṃ parivīya saptadaśabhir vāsobhir yūpam̐ veṣṭayati /
7.1.1.d: रशनां परिवीय सप्तदशभिर् वासोभिर् यूपम्̐ वेष्टयति /
7.1.1.m: Having wound the rope around, he wraps the sacrificial post with seventeen cloths.

7.1.1.s: siddha upavasathaḥ /
7.1.1.d: सिद्ध उपवसथः /

7.1.1.s: śvobhūte saptadaśo vājapeyaḥ ṣoḍaśimān rathantarapṛṣṭhaḥ //
7.1.1.d: श्वोभूते सप्तदशो वाजपेयः षोडशिमान् रथन्तरपृष्ठः //
7.1.1.m: On the next day, the seventeen-part Vājapeya takes place, possessing the sixteen-hymn cup, having the Rathantara as its back-chant.

7.1.1.s: deva savitaḥ prasuva yajñaṃ prasuva yajñapatiṃ bhagāya \\ iti savanādiṣu juhoti /
7.1.1.d: देव सवितः प्रसुव यज्ञं प्रसुव यज्ञपतिं भगाय \\ इति सवनादिषु जुहोति /
7.1.1.m: He offers at the beginnings of the pressings with: "O divine Savitṛ, impel the sacrifice, impel the lord of the sacrifice for good fortune!".

7.1.1.s: siddham ā pātraprayojanāt /
7.1.1.d: सिद्धम् आ पात्रप्रयोजनात् /
7.1.1.m: The procedure is established up to the employment of the vessels.

7.1.1.s: āgrāyaṇasthālīṃ prayujya pañcaindrāṇy atigrāhyapātrāṇi prayunakti /
7.1.1.d: आग्रायणस्थालीं प्रयुज्य पञ्चैन्द्राण्य् अतिग्राह्यपात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति /
7.1.1.m: Having employed the āgrāyaṇa vessel, he employs five supplementary draught-vessels dedicated to Indra.

7.1.1.s: dakṣiṇasminn am̐se saptadaśa prajāpatipātrāṇi vāyavyāni prayunakti /
7.1.1.d: दक्षिणस्मिन्न् अम्̐से सप्तदश प्रजापतिपात्राणि वायव्यानि प्रयुनक्ति /
7.1.1.m: On the southern corner, he employs seventeen Vāyavya vessels dedicated to Prajāpati.

7.1.1.s: sadhruvāṇi prayujyāparasmin khare pratiprasthātā saptadaśa mārttikān upayāmān vāladroṇaṃ ca /
7.1.1.d: सध्रुवाणि प्रयुज्यापरस्मिन् खरे प्रतिप्रस्थाता सप्तदश मार्त्तिकान् उपयामान् वालद्रोणं च /
7.1.1.m: Having employed [the vessels] along with the dhruvā cup, on the second mound the pratiprasthātṛ [employs] seventeen earthenware cups and a hair-sieve trough.

7.1.1.s: siddham ā savanīyakalaśānām̐ sādanāt /
7.1.1.d: सिद्धम् आ सवनीयकलशानाम्̐ सादनात् /
7.1.1.m: The procedure is established up to the placing of the vessels for the pressing.

7.1.1.s: surākalaśaṃ pratiprasthātotkaradeśa āgnīdhrasya mūrdhani sādayitvāparayā dvārā prapādya svasmin khare sādayati /
7.1.1.d: सुराकलशं प्रतिप्रस्थातोत्करदेश आग्नीध्रस्य मूर्धनि सादयित्वापरया द्वारा प्रपाद्य स्वस्मिन् खरे सादयति /
7.1.1.m: The pratiprasthātṛ, having set down the liquor jar in the rubbish heap area on the head of the āgnīdhra, bringing it in through the western door, sets it down on its own mound.

7.1.1.s: nigrābhyāsu yajamānam̐ vācayitvā dadhigrahapātre hotṛcamasād adābhyaṃ gṛhṇāti \\ agniḥ prātaḥsavanāt \\ iti tṛtīyagraham \\ viśve devā marutas \\ iti dvibhāgam idaṃ tṛtīyam̐ savanam iti saṃpūrayati //
7.1.1.d: निग्राभ्यासु यजमानम्̐ वाचयित्वा दधिग्रहपात्रे होतृचमसाद् अदाभ्यं गृह्णाति \\ अग्निः प्रातःसवनात् \\ इति तृतीयग्रहम् \\ विश्वे देवा मरुतस् \\ इति द्विभागम् इदं तृतीयम्̐ सवनम् इति संपूरयति //
7.1.1.m: Having made the sacrificer recite over the nigrābhyā waters, he draws the Adābhya cup from the hotṛ's cup into the curd-cup vessel; a third draught with: "Agni from the morning pressing..."; two parts with: "All-gods, Maruts..."; he fills it completely with: "This is the third pressing."

7.1.1.s: agnaye tvā pravṛhāmi \\ itiprabhṛtibhir ekaikena paryāyeṇa dvaudvāv am̐śū pravṛhati /
7.1.1.d: अग्नये त्वा प्रवृहामि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् एकैकेन पर्यायेण द्वौद्वाव् अम्̐शू प्रवृहति /
7.1.1.m: With each turn starting with: "For Agni I pluck you...", he plucks two stalks at a time.

7.1.1.s: tān ekadhā saṃgṛhya reśīnāṃ tvā patmann ādhūnomi \\ itiprabhṛtibhir dvābhyāṃdvābhyāṃ mantrābhyām̐ sakṛtsakṛd graham ādhūnoti //
7.1.1.d: तान् एकधा संगृह्य रेशीनां त्वा पत्मन्न् आधूनोमि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् द्वाभ्यांद्वाभ्यां मन्त्राभ्याम्̐ सकृत्सकृद् ग्रहम् आधूनोति //
7.1.1.m: Having gathered them together, he shakes the draught once with each pair of formulas starting with: "On the flight of the seers I shake you...".

7.1.1.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ śukraṃ tvā śukra śukrāya gṛhṇāmi \\ ity abhimṛśati /
7.1.1.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ शुक्रं त्वा शुक्र शुक्राय गृह्णामि \\ इत्य् अभिमृशति /
7.1.1.m: He touches it with: "You are taken with a support; I take you, the bright, for the bright one, O bright."

7.1.1.s: asanno hūyate /
7.1.1.d: असन्नो हूयते /

7.1.1.s: uttareṇa hotur gachati /
7.1.1.d: उत्तरेण होतुर् गछति /
7.1.1.m: He walks to the north of the hotṛ.

7.1.1.s: dakṣiṇenābhiprayamya grahaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhiṃ pratyavasthāya kakubham̐ rūpam̐ vṛṣabhasya rocate \\ iti juhoti /
7.1.1.d: दक्षिणेनाभिप्रयम्य ग्रहं दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिं प्रत्यवस्थाय ककुभम्̐ रूपम्̐ वृषभस्य रोचते \\ इति जुहोति /
7.1.1.m: Holding the cup forth to the south, stepping back toward the southern junction of the enclosing sticks, he offers with: "The peak form of the bull shines...".

7.1.1.s: pratiparikramya yathāsthānaṃ pātram̐ sādayati //
7.1.1.d: प्रतिपरिक्रम्य यथास्थानं पात्रम्̐ सादयति //
7.1.1.m: Turning back, he sets down the vessel in its proper place.

7.1.1.s: uśik tvaṃ deva soma \\ itiprabhṛtibhir ekaikena paryāyeṇa dvaudvāv am̐śū pratyavasṛjati /
7.1.1.d: उशिक् त्वं देव सोम \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् एकैकेन पर्यायेण द्वौद्वाव् अम्̐शू प्रत्यवसृजति /
7.1.1.m: With each turn starting with: "Longing, you, O divine Soma...", he puts two stalks back.

7.1.1.s: dakṣiṇā dadāti vāso 'dhīvāso hiraṇyaṃ dhenūś catasro 'ṣṭau dvādaśa vām̐śvadābhyayoḥ /
7.1.1.d: दक्षिणा ददाति वासो ऽधीवासो हिरण्यं धेनूश् चतस्रो ऽष्टौ द्वादश वाम्̐श्वदाभ्ययोः /
7.1.1.m: For the Aṃśu and Adābhya cups, he gives as sacrificial gifts a garment, an upper garment, gold, and four, eight, or twelve cows.

7.1.1.s: upām̐śusavanādānaprabhṛti siddham ādhiṣavaṇaphalakayor abhimantraṇāt /
7.1.1.d: उपाम्̐शुसवनादानप्रभृति सिद्धम् आधिषवणफलकयोर् अभिमन्त्रणात् /
7.1.1.m: From the taking of the pressing stone for the Upāṃśu cup onward, the procedure is established up to the recitation over the two pressing boards.

7.1.1.s: bhūtikāmasyām̐śuṃ gṛhṇīyāt /
7.1.1.d: भूतिकामस्याम्̐शुं गृह्णीयात् /
7.1.1.m: For one desiring prosperity, he should draw the Aṃśu cup.

7.1.1.s: upasarjanaprabhṛti na vyavāned ā homāt /
7.1.1.d: उपसर्जनप्रभृति न व्यवानेद् आ होमात् /
7.1.1.m: From the pouring of the water onward, he should not breathe out until the offering.

7.1.1.s:
yadi vyavāneta
ā naḥ prāṇa etu parāvata āntarikṣād divas pari /
āyuḥ pṛthivyā adhi\ amṛtam asi \ prāṇāya tvā //
iti hiraṇyam abhivyānayati /
7.1.1.d:
यदि व्यवानेत
आ नः प्राण एतु परावत आन्तरिक्षाद् दिवस् परि /
आयुः पृथिव्या अधि\ अमृतम् असि \ प्राणाय त्वा //
इति हिरण्यम् अभिव्यानयति /
7.1.1.m:
"May breath come to us from the distance, from the atmosphere, from the sky!

Life from above the earth; you are immortality; for breath, to you!"

with this, he breathes upon the gold.

7.1.1.s: hotṛcamasāt sakṛd upasṛjya sakṛd abhiṣuṇoti //
7.1.1.d: होतृचमसात् सकृद् उपसृज्य सकृद् अभिषुणोति //
7.1.1.m: Having poured water once from the hotṛ's cup, he presses once.

7.1.1.s: kayā naś citra ābhuvad ity etāṃ manasānudrutya dadhigrahapātre 'ñjalinā sakṛd ānayati //
7.1.1.d: कया नश् चित्र आभुवद् इत्य् एतां मनसानुद्रुत्य दधिग्रहपात्रे ऽञ्जलिना सकृद् आनयति //
7.1.1.m: Having recited mentally: "With what aid did the wonderful one appear...", he pours [the juice] once into the curd-cup vessel with his cupped hands.

7.1.1.s: dadhanve vā yad īm anu \\ iti juhoti /
7.1.1.d: दधन्वे वा यद् ईम् अनु \\ इति जुहोति /
7.1.1.m: He offers with: "Or when it has flown along it...".

7.1.1.s:
indrāgnī me varcaḥ kṛṇutām\ varcaḥ somo bṛhaspatiḥ /
varco me viśve devās\ varco me dhattam aśvinā //
ity apa upaspṛśati /
7.1.1.d:
इन्द्राग्नी मे वर्चः कृणुताम्\ वर्चः सोमो बृहस्पतिः /
वर्चो मे विश्वे देवास्\ वर्चो मे धत्तम् अश्विना //
इत्य् अप उपस्पृशति /
7.1.1.m:
"May Indra and Agni grant me splendour; / Soma and Bṛhaspati splendour!

Splendour to me all the gods; / grant me splendour, O Aśvins!"

7.1.1.s: am̐śvadābhyau gṛhṇīte sahasradakṣiṇe sarvavedasadakṣiṇe sattre viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe vājapeye rājasūye 'śvamedhe ca /
7.1.1.d: अम्̐श्वदाभ्यौ गृह्णीते सहस्रदक्षिणे सर्ववेदसदक्षिणे सत्त्रे विश्वजिति सर्वपृष्ठे वाजपेये राजसूये ऽश्वमेधे च /
7.1.1.m: He draws the Aṃśu and Adābhya cups at a sacrifice with a thousand sacrificial gifts, a sacrifice with all possessions given as sacrificial gifts, a sattra, the Viśvajit, the Sarvapṛṣṭha, the Vājapeya, the Rājasūya, and the Aśvamedha.

7.1.1.s: upām̐śvabhiṣavaprabhṛti siddham ā manthino grahaṇāt /
7.1.1.d: उपाम्̐श्वभिषवप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ मन्थिनो ग्रहणात् /
7.1.1.m: From the pressing for the Upāṃśu cup onward, the procedure is established up to the drawing of the Manthin cup.

7.1.1.s: antarukthya āgrāyaṇaṃ gṛhītvā \\ upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ druṣadaṃ tvā \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ pañcaindrān atigrāhyān gṛhṇāti /
7.1.1.d: अन्तरुक्थ्य आग्रायणं गृहीत्वा \\ उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ द्रुषदं त्वा \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः पञ्चैन्द्रान् अतिग्राह्यान् गृह्णाति /
7.1.1.m: Having drawn the Āgrāyaṇa cup in the middle of the ukthya cups, he draws five supplementary cups dedicated to Indra with formulas starting with: "You are taken with a support; you who sit in the tree...".

7.1.1.s: sadhruvān gṛhītvā na śukradhārām̐ samatipāvayet /
7.1.1.d: सध्रुवान् गृहीत्वा न शुक्रधाराम्̐ समतिपावयेत् /
7.1.1.m: Having drawn them along with the dhruvā cup, he should not let the stream of the pure Soma cross over.

7.1.1.s: droṇe vālam̐ vitatya pratiprasthātā punātu te parisrutam iti surām atipāvayati //
7.1.1.d: द्रोणे वालम्̐ वितत्य प्रतिप्रस्थाता पुनातु ते परिस्रुतम् इति सुराम् अतिपावयति //
7.1.1.m: Having spread the hair-sieve over the trough, the pratiprasthātṛ filters the liquor with: "May he purify your fermented liquor...".

7.1.1.s: kuvid aṅga yavamantas \\ iti śukradhārayādhvaryuḥ saptadaśa prājāpatyān grahān gṛhṇāti \\ ayā viṣṭhā \\ iti pratiprasthātopayāmeṣu surāgrahān /
7.1.1.d: कुविद् अङ्ग यवमन्तस् \\ इति शुक्रधारयाध्वर्युः सप्तदश प्राजापत्यान् ग्रहान् गृह्णाति \\ अया विष्ठा \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थातोपयामेषु सुराग्रहान् /
7.1.1.m: With: "Indeed, do the barley-growers...", with the stream of pure Soma, the adhvaryu draws seventeen cups dedicated to Prajāpati; the pratiprasthātṛ [draws] the liquor-cups in the earthenware cups with: "By this path...".

7.1.1.s: vyatyāsaṃ prājāpatyānāṃ grahaṇam̐ sādanaṃ ca /
7.1.1.d: व्यत्यासं प्राजापत्यानां ग्रहणम्̐ सादनं च /
7.1.1.m: The taking and the placing of the Prājāpatya cups are performed alternately.

7.1.2.s: siddham ā raśanākālāt /
7.1.2.d: सिद्धम् आ रशनाकालात् /

7.1.2.s: raśanām̐ parivīya paśūn upākaroty āgneyam ajam aindrāgnam ajam aindram̐ vṛṣṇim̐ sārasvatīṃ meṣīm mārutīṃ pṛśniṃ vaśām̐ sārasvatyau meṣyau saptadaśa prājāpatyān ajāñ śyāmām̐s tūparān ekarūpān /
7.1.2.d: रशनाम्̐ परिवीय पशून् उपाकरोत्य् आग्नेयम् अजम् ऐन्द्राग्नम् अजम् ऐन्द्रम्̐ वृष्णिम्̐ सारस्वतीं मेषीम् मारुतीं पृश्निं वशाम्̐ सारस्वत्यौ मेष्यौ सप्तदश प्राजापत्यान् अजाञ् श्यामाम्̐स् तूपरान् एकरूपान् /
7.1.2.m: Having wound round the halter cord, he brings forward the sacrificial animals: a he-goat for Agni, a he-goat for Indra-and-Agni, a ram for Indra, a ewe for Sarasvatī, a dappled barren cow for the Maruts, two ewes for Sarasvatī, [and] seventeen hornless, uniform dark-brown he-goats for Prajāpati.

7.1.2.s: yathāmnātam̐ vapābhiś caranti /
7.1.2.d: यथाम्नातम्̐ वपाभिश् चरन्ति /
7.1.2.m: They proceed with the omenta as prescribed.

7.1.2.s: siddham ā mādhyaṃdinīyānāṃ nirvapanāt /
7.1.2.d: सिद्धम् आ माध्यंदिनीयानां निर्वपनात् /
7.1.2.m: [The procedure is] established up to the apportioning of the midday oblations.

7.1.2.s: mādhyaṃdinīyān nirupya naivāraṃ nirvapati bārhaspatyam̐ saptadaśaśarāvam /
7.1.2.d: माध्यंदिनीयान् निरुप्य नैवारं निर्वपति बार्हस्पत्यम्̐ सप्तदशशरावम् /
7.1.2.m: Having apportioned the midday oblations, he apportions an oblation of wild rice in seventeen platters for Bṛhaspati.

7.1.2.s: siddham ādhiśrayaṇāt /
7.1.2.d: सिद्धम् आधिश्रयणात् /

7.1.2.s: mādhyaṃdinīyān adhiśritya naivāraṃ payasi śrapayati /
7.1.2.d: माध्यंदिनीयान् अधिश्रित्य नैवारं पयसि श्रपयति /
7.1.2.m: Having placed [the oblations] of the midday service on the fire, he cooks the wild-rice oblation in milk.

7.1.2.s: siddham ā pracaraṇāt
7.1.2.d: सिद्धम् आ प्रचरणात्

7.1.2.s: mādhyaṃdinīyaiḥ pracarya naivāreṇa pracarati bṛhaspataye 'nubrūhi \ bṛhaspatim̐ yaja \\ ity upām̐śudevatena /
7.1.2.d: माध्यंदिनीयैः प्रचर्य नैवारेण प्रचरति बृहस्पतये ऽनुब्रूहि \ बृहस्पतिम्̐ यज \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुदेवतेन /
7.1.2.m: Having performed the offerings of the midday service, he performs the offering with the wild rice with a whisper-deity, saying: “Recite for Bṛhaspati,” “Sacrifice to Bṛhaspati.”

7.1.2.s: samānam̐ sviṣṭakṛt samānām iḍām̐ hṛtvā naivāraṃ cātvāle 'vadadhāti /
7.1.2.d: समानम्̐ स्विष्टकृत् समानाम् इडाम्̐ हृत्वा नैवारं चात्वाले ऽवदधाति /
7.1.2.m: Having performed the same Sviṣṭakṛt offering and the same iḍā portion, he deposits the wild-rice oblation into the cātvāla trench.

7.1.2.s: siddham ā dakṣiṇākālāt /
7.1.2.d: सिद्धम् आ दक्षिणाकालात् /
7.1.2.m: The procedure is established up to the time for the sacrificial gifts.

7.1.2.s: ṣoḍaśartvijo hiraṇyasraja ābadhnīte //
7.1.2.d: षोडशर्त्विजो हिरण्यस्रज आबध्नीते //
7.1.2.m: The sixteen officiating priests put on gold garlands.

7.1.2.s: vājasya nu prasave mātaraṃ mahīm iti ratham upāvaharati dakṣinataḥ prāgvam̐śasyāhitam //
7.1.2.d: वाजस्य नु प्रसवे मातरं महीम् इति रथम् उपावहरति दक्षिनतः प्राग्वम्̐शस्याहितम् //
7.1.2.m: With: “Now in the impulse of food, the great mother...”, he brings down the chariot stationed to the south of the hall with east-pointing beams.

7.1.2.s: apsv antar amṛtam apsu bheṣajam ity aśvān snapayanti vāyur vā tvā manur vā tvā \\ iti yunakti //
7.1.2.d: अप्स्व् अन्तर् अमृतम् अप्सु भेषजम् इत्य् अश्वान् स्नपयन्ति वायुर् वा त्वा मनुर् वा त्वा \\ इति युनक्ति //
7.1.2.m: With: “Within the waters is immortality, within the waters is healing,” they bathe the horses; with: “Either Vāyu [harness] you or Manu [harness] you,” he yokes them.

7.1.2.s: apām̐ napād āśuhemann iti rarāṭāni pratimārṣṭi /
7.1.2.d: अपाम्̐ नपाद् आशुहेमन्न् इति रराटानि प्रतिमार्ष्टि /
7.1.2.m: With: “O Apāṃ Napāt, swift-impelling,” he wipes their foreheads.

7.1.2.s: tūṣṇīṃ ṣoḍaśa rathā yujyante /
7.1.2.d: तूष्णीं षोडश रथा युज्यन्ते /
7.1.2.m: Silently sixteen chariots are yoked.

7.1.2.s: dākṣiṇau homau hutvā saptadaśa saptadaśāni dadāti saptadaśa niṣkān saptadaśa dāsīḥ saptadaśa hastinaḥ saptadaśa gavām̐ śatāni saptadaśāmīnām̐ saptadaśājānām̐ saptadaśa rathān saptadaśārohaṇāni /
7.1.2.d: दाक्षिणौ होमौ हुत्वा सप्तदश सप्तदशानि ददाति सप्तदश निष्कान् सप्तदश दासीः सप्तदश हस्तिनः सप्तदश गवाम्̐ शतानि सप्तदशामीनाम्̐ सप्तदशाजानाम्̐ सप्तदश रथान् सप्तदशारोहणानि /
7.1.2.m: Having offered the two oblations for the sacrificial gifts, he gives seventeen sets of seventeen: seventeen golden ornaments, seventeen female slaves, seventeen elephants, seventeen hundred cows, seventeen [hundred] ewes, seventeen [hundred] goats, seventeen chariots, and seventeen chariot-seats.

7.1.2.s: saptadaśa saptadaśāni puṣkalaiḥ pūrayitvā yajuryuktam adhvaryave dadāti /
7.1.2.d: सप्तदश सप्तदशानि पुष्कलैः पूरयित्वा यजुर्युक्तम् अध्वर्यवे ददाति /
7.1.2.m: Having filled seventeen sets of seventeen with full measures, he gives the one yoked with sacred formulas to the adhvaryu priest.

7.1.2.s: gā agrato nayanti madhyata itarāṇi paścād rathān /
7.1.2.d: गा अग्रतो नयन्ति मध्यत इतराणि पश्चाद् रथान् /
7.1.2.m: They lead the cows in front, the other [gifts] in the middle, and the chariots behind.

7.1.2.s: nītāsu dakṣiṇāsu cātvālānte yajuryukto 'vatiṣṭhata uttarata āgnīdhrasyetare /
7.1.2.d: नीतासु दक्षिणासु चात्वालान्ते यजुर्युक्तो ऽवतिष्ठत उत्तरत आग्नीध्रस्येतरे /
7.1.2.m: When the sacrificial gifts have been led away, the one yoked with sacred formulas stands at the edge of the cātvāla trench, and the others to the north of the āgnīdhra fire.

7.1.2.s: māhendrakāle śilpāni vyāyātayanti /
7.1.2.d: माहेन्द्रकाले शिल्पानि व्यायातयन्ति /
7.1.2.m: At the time of the Māhendra cup, they display the craft-performances.

7.1.2.s: dikṣu dundubhayo vadanti /
7.1.2.d: दिक्षु दुन्दुभयो वदन्ति /
7.1.2.m: In the quarters [of space], war-drums sound.

7.1.2.s: uttarataś cātvālasya rathākṣaṃ nighnanti /
7.1.2.d: उत्तरतश् चात्वालस्य रथाक्षं निघ्नन्ति /
7.1.2.m: To the north of the cātvāla trench they drive in a chariot axle.

7.1.2.s: tasmin rathacakraṃ pratimuñcaty audumbaram̐ saptadaśāram /
7.1.2.d: तस्मिन् रथचक्रं प्रतिमुञ्चत्य् औदुम्बरम्̐ सप्तदशारम् /
7.1.2.m: On it he fixes a chariot wheel made of udumbara wood with seventeen spokes.

7.1.2.s: saptadaśoṣapuṭān aśvatthaparṇeṣūpanaddhām̐ś caturṣu vam̐śeṣūpanahyati caturaścaturaḥ pañcaikasmin //
7.1.2.d: सप्तदशोषपुटान् अश्वत्थपर्णेषूपनद्धाम्̐श् चतुर्षु वम्̐शेषूपनह्यति चतुरश्चतुरः पञ्चैकस्मिन् //
7.1.2.m: He ties seventeen packets of saline soil wrapped in aśvattha leaves onto four bamboo poles: four on each, and five on one.

7.1.2.s: devasya savituḥ prasave satyasavaso varṣiṣṭhaṃ nākam̐ ruheyam iti brahmā rathacakram āruhya pradakṣiṇaṃ trir āvadhyati //
7.1.2.d: देवस्य सवितुः प्रसवे सत्यसवसो वर्षिष्ठं नाकम्̐ रुहेयम् इति ब्रह्मा रथचक्रम् आरुह्य प्रदक्षिणं त्रिर् आवध्यति //
7.1.2.m: With: “At the impulse of the god Savitṛ, of true impulse, may I ascend to the highest firmament,” the brahman priest mounts the chariot wheel and turns it clockwise three times.

7.1.2.s: vājinām̐ sāma gāya \\ iti preṣyati /
7.1.2.d: वाजिनाम्̐ साम गाय \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
7.1.2.m: He gives the order: “Sing the saman of the coursers!”

7.1.2.s: ujjitīr yajamānam̐ vācayati \\ agnir ekākṣarām udajayad iti trīn paryāyān agnaya ekākṣarāya chandase svāhā \\ iti saptadaśāhutīr juhoti //
7.1.2.d: उज्जितीर् यजमानम्̐ वाचयति \\ अग्निर् एकाक्षराम् उदजयद् इति त्रीन् पर्यायान् अग्नय एकाक्षराय छन्दसे स्वाहा \\ इति सप्तदशाहुतीर् जुहोति //
7.1.2.m: He causes the sacrificer to recite the Ujjiti formulas: “Agni won through the single-syllabled [metre]...” through three turns; with: “To Agni, to the single-syllabled metre, svāhā!” he offers seventeen oblations.

7.1.2.s: viṣṇoḥ krāntam asi \ viṣṇor vikrāntam asi \ viṣṇor vikramaṇam asi \\ iti yajamānam̐ yajuryuktāya prakramayati /
7.1.2.d: विष्णोः क्रान्तम् असि \ विष्णोर् विक्रान्तम् असि \ विष्णोर् विक्रमणम् असि \\ इति यजमानम्̐ यजुर्युक्ताय प्रक्रमयति /
7.1.2.m: With: “You are the stride of Viṣṇu,” “You are the wide stride of Viṣṇu,” “You are the step of Viṣṇu,” he makes the sacrificer step forward toward the [chariot] yoked with sacred formulas.

7.1.2.s:
aṅkau nyaṅkāv abhito ratham̐ ye \ dhvāntā vātāgnim abhisaṃcaranti /
dūrehetiḥ patatrī vājinīvām̐s \ te no 'gnayaḥ paprayaḥ pālayantu //
iti cakre 'bhimantrayate vanaspate vīḍvaṅgas \\ ity adhiṣṭhānam //
7.1.2.d:
अङ्कौ न्यङ्काव् अभितो रथम्̐ ये \ ध्वान्ता वाताग्निम् अभिसंचरन्ति /
दूरेहेतिः पतत्री वाजिनीवाम्̐स् \ ते नो ऽग्नयः पप्रयः पालयन्तु //
इति चक्रे ऽभिमन्त्रयते वनस्पते वीड्वङ्गस् \\ इत्य् अधिष्ठानम् //
7.1.2.m:
“The two curves, the two dips around the chariot, which / moving in the dark approach the wind-driven fire,

having weapons far-reaching, flying, rich in coursers: / may those fires, spreading abroad, protect us.”

With this [verse] he addresses the two wheels; with: “O tree of the forest, strong-limbed...” [he addresses] the chariot standing-place.

7.1.2.s: devasya vayam̐ savituḥ prasave satyasavanasya bṛhaspater vājino vājajito vājaṃ jeṣma \\ iti ratham ārohati //
7.1.2.d: देवस्य वयम्̐ सवितुः प्रसवे सत्यसवनस्य बृहस्पतेर् वाजिनो वाजजितो वाजं जेष्म \\ इति रथम् आरोहति //
7.1.2.m: With: “At the impulse of the god Savitṛ of true impulse, may we win the prize of Bṛhaspati, the runner, the prize-winner,” he mounts the chariot.

7.1.2.s: vājam̐ vājino jayata \\ ity anuvākaṃ nigadyāvarohati /
7.1.2.d: वाजम्̐ वाजिनो जयत \\ इत्य् अनुवाकं निगद्यावरोहति /
7.1.2.m: Having recited the section: “Win the prize, O coursers!”, he steps down.

7.1.2.s: avarūḍhe pratihito rājaputra ārohati //
7.1.2.d: अवरूढे प्रतिहितो राजपुत्र आरोहति //
7.1.2.m: When he has stepped down, an appointed prince mounts.

7.1.2.s: aśvājini vājini vājeṣu vājinīvati \\ ity aśvājinīm ādatte //
7.1.2.d: अश्वाजिनि वाजिनि वाजेषु वाजिनीवति \\ इत्य् अश्वाजिनीम् आदत्ते //
7.1.2.m: With: “O horse-whip, swift, rich in prizes among the contests,” he takes up the horse-whip.

7.1.2.s: arvāsi \ saptir asi \\ ity aśvān adhikṣipati /
7.1.2.d: अर्वासि \ सप्तिर् असि \\ इत्य् अश्वान् अधिक्षिपति /
7.1.2.m: With: “You are a courser,” “You are a racer,” he urges on the horses.

7.1.2.s: viśa itarān ārohanti /
7.1.2.d: विश इतरान् आरोहन्ति /

7.1.2.s: uttarataś cātvālasya saptadaśasv iṣupratyāseṣv audumbarīm̐ sthūṇāṃ nighnanti /
7.1.2.d: उत्तरतश् चात्वालस्य सप्तदशस्व् इषुप्रत्यासेष्व् औदुम्बरीम्̐ स्थूणां निघ्नन्ति /
7.1.2.m: To the north of the cātvāla trench, at seventeen arrow-shots distance, they drive in a post of udumbara wood.

7.1.2.s: tāṃ kāṣṭhety ācakṣate /
7.1.2.d: तां काष्ठेत्य् आचक्षते /

7.1.2.s: tāṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā pratyāyanti /
7.1.2.d: तां प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा प्रत्यायन्ति /
7.1.2.m: Having gone around it clockwise, they drive back.

7.1.3.s: māhendraṃ gṛhītvā stotram upākaroti /
7.1.3.d: माहेन्द्रं गृहीत्वा स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति /
7.1.3.m: Having drawn the Māhendra cup, he introduces the chant.

7.1.3.s: patnī darbhamayam̐ vāsaḥ paridhatte tārpyam̐ yajamānaḥ kṣaumam̐ sarpiṣi paryastam abhyañjane vā /
7.1.3.d: पत्नी दर्भमयम्̐ वासः परिधत्ते तार्प्यम्̐ यजमानः क्षौमम्̐ सर्पिषि पर्यस्तम् अभ्यञ्जने वा /
7.1.3.m: The wife puts on a garment made of darbha grass; the sacrificer, a garment of tārpya cloth, or linen soaked in clarified butter, or in ointment.

7.1.3.s: yūpam ārokṣyan yajamānaḥ svo rohāvehi \\ iti patnīm āmantrayate svo rohāva \\ iti pratyāha //
7.1.3.d: यूपम् आरोक्ष्यन् यजमानः स्वो रोहावेहि \\ इति पत्नीम् आमन्त्रयते स्वो रोहाव \\ इति प्रत्याह //
7.1.3.m: About to climb the sacrificial post, the sacrificer calls to his wife: “Come, let us two climb to heaven”; she replies: “Let us two climb to heaven.”

7.1.3.s: ahaṃ nāv ubhayoḥ svo rokṣyāmi \\ ity uktvā \\ āyur yajñena kalpate \ prāṇo yajñena kalpate \\ iti sṛgayārohati //
7.1.3.d: अहं नाव् उभयोः स्वो रोक्ष्यामि \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा \\ आयुर् यज्ञेन कल्पते \ प्राणो यज्ञेन कल्पते \\ इति सृगयारोहति //
7.1.3.m: Having said: “I shall climb to heaven for both of us,” he climbs by means of the ladder, saying: “May life-span be shaped through the sacrifice; may breath be shaped through the sacrifice.”

7.1.3.s: svar devā agāma \\ ity āruhya japati yajamānaḥ //
7.1.3.d: स्वर् देवा अगाम \\ इत्य् आरुह्य जपति यजमानः //
7.1.3.m: Having climbed up, the sacrificer mutters: “We have gone to heaven, to the gods.”

7.1.3.s: vājāya svāhā \ prasavāya svāhā \\ iti trayodaśāhutīr juhoti /
7.1.3.d: वाजाय स्वाहा \ प्रसवाय स्वाहा \\ इति त्रयोदशाहुतीर् जुहोति /
7.1.3.m: With: “To the prize, svāhā!”, “To the impulse, svāhā!”, he offers thirteen oblations.

7.1.3.s: viśa upatalpeṣu tiṣṭhantas \\ annāya tvā \ vājāya tvā \ vājajityāyai tvā \\ ity ūṣapuṭair āghnate //
7.1.3.d: विश उपतल्पेषु तिष्ठन्तस् \\ अन्नाय त्वा \ वाजाय त्वा \ वाजजित्यायै त्वा \\ इत्य् ऊषपुटैर् आघ्नते //
7.1.3.m: Commoners standing on lower platforms pelt [him] with the packets of saline soil, saying: “For food [we pelt] you; for the prize [we pelt] you; for the winning of the prize [we pelt] you.”

7.1.3.s: taṃtam abhiparyāvartate //
7.1.3.d: तंतम् अभिपर्यावर्तते //
7.1.3.m: He turns around towards each of them.

7.1.3.s: ā mā vājasya prasavo jagamyād iti ratheṣu punar āsṛteṣu juhoti //
7.1.3.d: आ मा वाजस्य प्रसवो जगम्याद् इति रथेषु पुनर् आसृतेषु जुहोति //
7.1.3.m: With: “May the impulse of the prize come to me,” he offers an oblation as the chariots run back.

7.1.3.s: indrāya vācam̐ vadata \\ iti dundubhīn vadato 'numantrayate //
7.1.3.d: इन्द्राय वाचम्̐ वदत \\ इति दुन्दुभीन् वदतो ऽनुमन्त्रयते //
7.1.3.m: With: “Utter a voice for Indra,” he accompanies the sounding war-drums with a mantra.

7.1.3.s: ajījapata vanaspatayas \\ indrāya vācam̐ vimucyadhvam iti rathavimocanīyaṃ juhoti /
7.1.3.d: अजीजपत वनस्पतयस् \\ इन्द्राय वाचम्̐ विमुच्यध्वम् इति रथविमोचनीयं जुहोति /
7.1.3.m: With: “You have caused to win, O trees of the forest... unyoke your voice for Indra,” he offers the chariot-unyoking oblation.

7.1.3.s: ājisṛdbhyaḥ kṛṣṇalam ekaikaṃ prayachati //
7.1.3.d: आजिसृद्भ्यः कृष्णलम् एकैकं प्रयछति //
7.1.3.m: He gives one gold kṛṣṇala berry weight to each of the chariot-racers.

7.1.3.s: vājinau vājijitau vājaṃ jitvā bṛhaspater bhāgam avajighratam iti yajuryuktasya dhuryau naivāram upaghrāpayati //
7.1.3.d: वाजिनौ वाजिजितौ वाजं जित्वा बृहस्पतेर् भागम् अवजिघ्रतम् इति यजुर्युक्तस्य धुर्यौ नैवारम् उपघ्रापयति //
7.1.3.m: With: “O coursers, prize-winners, having won the prize, smell the share of Bṛhaspati,” he makes the two yoke-horses of the chariot yoked with sacred formulas smell the wild-rice oblation.

7.1.3.s: vājinau vājajitau vājaṃ jitvā bṛhaspater bhāge nimṛjyethām iti pṛṣṭhyayor mukhayor lepaṃ nimārṣṭi //
7.1.3.d: वाजिनौ वाजजितौ वाजं जित्वा बृहस्पतेर् भागे निमृज्येथाम् इति पृष्ठ्ययोर् मुखयोर् लेपं निमार्ष्टि //
7.1.3.m: With: “O coursers, prize-winners, having won the prize, be wiped on the share of Bṛhaspati,” he wipes the smear [of the oblation] on the mouths of the two horses behind the yoke.

7.1.3.s: yantrī rāḍ \ yantry asi yamanī \ dhartry asi dharuṇā \ kṛṣyai tvā \ kṣemāya tvā \\ ity avarohati //
7.1.3.d: यन्त्री राड् \ यन्त्र्य् असि यमनी \ धर्त्र्य् असि धरुणा \ कृष्यै त्वा \ क्षेमाय त्वा \\ इत्य् अवरोहति //
7.1.3.m: With: “The restrainer is the ruler; you are the restrainer, the controller; you are the supporter, the support; for agriculture [I descend] to you; for security [I descend] to you,” he steps down.

7.1.3.s: tejo 'si \\ iti hiraṇyam abhyavarohate puṣṭir asi \\ iti bastājinam //
7.1.3.d: तेजो ऽसि \\ इति हिरण्यम् अभ्यवरोहते पुष्टिर् असि \\ इति बस्ताजिनम् //
7.1.3.m: With: “You are brilliance,” he steps down onto a piece of gold; with: “You are nourishment,” onto a he-goat skin.

7.1.3.s: samrāḍ asi \\ ity āsandyāṃ kṛṣṇājinam āstīrya bastājinaṃ paśukāmasya viṣṇoḥ krāntam asi \ viṣṇor vikrāntam asi \ viṣṇor vikramaṇam asi \\ iti yajamānam āsandīṃ prakramayati //
7.1.3.d: सम्राड् असि \\ इत्य् आसन्द्यां कृष्णाजिनम् आस्तीर्य बस्ताजिनं पशुकामस्य विष्णोः क्रान्तम् असि \ विष्णोर् विक्रान्तम् असि \ विष्णोर् विक्रमणम् असि \\ इति यजमानम् आसन्दीं प्रक्रमयति //
7.1.3.m: With: “You are sovereign,” having spread a black antelope skin on a wicker chair—or a he-goat skin for one who desires livestock—he makes the sacrificer step forward to the chair with: “You are the stride of Viṣṇu,” “You are the wide stride of Viṣṇu,” “You are the step of Viṣṇu.”

7.1.3.s: divaṃ proṣṭhanīm āroha tām āruhya prapaśyaikarāṇ manuṣyāṇām \\ kṛṣyai kṣemāya rayyai poṣāya tvā \\ ity āsandīm ārohantam anumantrayate /
7.1.3.d: दिवं प्रोष्ठनीम् आरोह ताम् आरुह्य प्रपश्यैकराण् मनुष्याणाम् \\ कृष्यै क्षेमाय रय्यै पोषाय त्वा \\ इत्य् आसन्दीम् आरोहन्तम् अनुमन्त्रयते /
7.1.3.m: With: “Mount the throne of heaven; having mounted it, look forth as the sole king of men; for agriculture, for security, for wealth, for prosperity [I seat] you,” he accompanies him with a mantra as he mounts the chair.

7.1.3.s: oṣadhīr āraṇyā grāmyāś ca sarpiṣā sam̐sṛjya vājaprasavyam audumbareṇa sruveṇa juhoti \\ agne achā vadeha nas \\ iti saptabhiḥ /
7.1.3.d: ओषधीर् आरण्या ग्राम्याश् च सर्पिषा सम्̐सृज्य वाजप्रसव्यम् औदुम्बरेण स्रुवेण जुहोति \\ अग्ने अछा वदेह नस् \\ इति सप्तभिः /
7.1.3.m: Having mixed wild and cultivated plants with clarified butter, he offers the vājaprasavya libations with an udumbara ladle with the seven [mantras beginning with] 'Agni, speak to us here.'

7.1.3.s: vyākhyāto 'bhiṣekaḥ /
7.1.3.d: व्याख्यातो ऽभिषेकः /

7.1.3.s: athāsmai chatram̐ prayachanty audumbaram̐ saptadaśasalākam //
7.1.3.d: अथास्मै छत्रम्̐ प्रयछन्त्य् औदुम्बरम्̐ सप्तदशसलाकम् //
7.1.3.m: Then they hand him an udumbara parasol with seventeen ribs.

7.1.3.s: chadir asi \\ iti yajamānaḥ pratigṛhṇāti /
7.1.3.d: छदिर् असि \\ इति यजमानः प्रतिगृह्णाति /
7.1.3.m: The sacrificer receives it with [the formula], 'You are a roof.'

7.1.3.s: samāpte śastre graham ādatte 'dhvaryur mukhyaṃ cātigrāhyāṇāṃ māhendram /
7.1.3.d: समाप्ते शस्त्रे ग्रहम् आदत्ते ऽध्वर्युर् मुख्यं चातिग्राह्याणां माहेन्द्रम् /
7.1.3.m: When the recitation is finished, the adhvaryu takes the cup of the atigrāhya cups, beginning with the Māhendra cup.

7.1.3.s: atigrāhyān upatiṣṭhante //
7.1.3.d: अतिग्राह्यान् उपतिष्ठन्ते //
7.1.3.m: They stand by the atigrāhya cups.

7.1.3.s: indrāya svāhā \\ iti vaṣaṭkṛte juhoty agre 'tigrāhyāṇām /
7.1.3.d: इन्द्राय स्वाहा \\ इति वषट्कृते जुहोत्य् अग्रे ऽतिग्राह्याणाम् /
7.1.3.m: When the vaṣaṭ has been uttered, he offers first of the atigrāhya cups with [the formula], 'To Indra, hail!'

7.1.3.s: tūṣṇīm anuvaṣaṭkṛte 'tigṛhyān bhakṣayate yathā māhendram /
7.1.3.d: तूष्णीम् अनुवषट्कृते ऽतिगृह्यान् भक्षयते यथा माहेन्द्रम् /
7.1.3.m: When the subsequent vaṣaṭ has been uttered silently, they consume the atigrāhya cups as in the case of the Māhendra cup.

7.1.3.s: siddham ā ṣoḍaśicamasebhyaḥ /
7.1.3.d: सिद्धम् आ षोडशिचमसेभ्यः /
7.1.3.m: The procedure is established up to the ṣoḍaśin cups.

7.1.3.s: apāvṛtteṣu ṣoḍaśikeṣu vājapeyakān unnayati hotṛcamasamukhyān /
7.1.3.d: अपावृत्तेषु षोडशिकेषु वाजपेयकान् उन्नयति होतृचमसमुख्यान् /
7.1.3.m: When the ṣoḍaśin cups have been removed, he draws the Vājapeya cups, beginning with the hotṛ's cup.

7.1.3.s: sarvaṃ pūtabhṛto hotṛcamasam ādatte 'dhvaryur mukhyaṃ ca prājāpatyānām //
7.1.3.d: सर्वं पूतभृतो होतृचमसम् आदत्ते ऽध्वर्युर् मुख्यं च प्राजापत्यानाम् //
7.1.3.m: The adhvaryu takes all [the soma] from the pūtabhṛt into the hotṛ's cup and the chief of the Prājāpatya cups.

7.1.3.s: saṃpṛca stha saṃ mā bhadreṇa pṛṅkta \\ iti pūrvayā dvārā prañcaḥ somair utkrāmanti vipṛca stha \ vi mā pāpmanā pṛṅkta \\ ity aparayā dvārā pratyañcaḥ suropayāmaiḥ //
7.1.3.d: संपृच स्थ सं मा भद्रेण पृङ्क्त \\ इति पूर्वया द्वारा प्रञ्चः सोमैर् उत्क्रामन्ति विपृच स्थ \ वि मा पाप्मना पृङ्क्त \\ इत्य् अपरया द्वारा प्रत्यञ्चः सुरोपयामैः //
7.1.3.m: With [the mantra], 'You are united, unite me with good fortune,' they go out eastward through the eastern door with the somas; with [the mantra], 'You are separated, separate me from evil,' westward through the western door with the surā cups.

7.1.3.s: prajāpataye svāhā \\ iti vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti prājāpatyānām /
7.1.3.d: प्रजापतये स्वाहा \\ इति वषट्कृते जुहोति प्राजापत्यानाम् /
7.1.3.m: When the vaṣaṭ has been uttered, he offers of the Prājāpatya cups with [the formula], 'To Prajāpati, hail!'

7.1.3.s: tūṣṇīm anuvaṣaṭkṛta udīco 'ṅgārān upohya surāgrahān vyunmarśam̐ somabhakṣān sarve bhakṣayanti /
7.1.3.d: तूष्णीम् अनुवषट्कृत उदीचो ऽङ्गारान् उपोह्य सुराग्रहान् व्युन्मर्शम्̐ सोमभक्षान् सर्वे भक्षयन्ति /
7.1.3.m: When the subsequent vaṣaṭ has been uttered silently, having shoved the embers toward the north and having touched the surā cups, all consume the soma portions.

7.1.3.s: ardhavaśāṃ ca suropayāmām̐ś cājisṛdbhyo haranti madhuṣṭhālaṃ brahmaṇe sauvarṇam̐ rājatam̐ vā kakubhaṃ pratihitāya mukhyam̐ surāgrahāṇām /
7.1.3.d: अर्धवशां च सुरोपयामाम्̐श् चाजिसृद्भ्यो हरन्ति मधुष्ठालं ब्रह्मणे सौवर्णम्̐ राजतम्̐ वा ककुभं प्रतिहिताय मुख्यम्̐ सुराग्रहाणाम् /
7.1.3.m: And they carry half a barren cow and the surā cups to the chariot-racers, a vessel of honey made of gold or silver to the brahman, and the best of the surā cups to the charioteer.

7.1.3.s: anuyājaiḥ pracarya siddhā sam̐sthā /
7.1.3.d: अनुयाजैः प्रचर्य सिद्धा सम्̐स्था /
7.1.3.m: Having performed [the rites] with the after-offerings, the conclusion is established.

7.1.3.s: na vājapeyayājī kaṃcana pratyavarohen na pratyuttiṣṭhed yathāvayasaṃ ced vājapeyayājinam //
7.1.3.d: न वाजपेययाजी कंचन प्रत्यवरोहेन् न प्रत्युत्तिष्ठेद् यथावयसं चेद् वाजपेययाजिनम् //
7.1.3.m: One who has performed the Vājapeya should not step down for anyone, nor should he rise to greet [anyone], unless it be someone who has performed the Vājapeya of comparable age.

7.1.3.s: samrāḍ ity etam ācakṣīran /
7.1.3.d: सम्राड् इत्य् एतम् आचक्षीरन् /
7.1.3.m: They should address him as 'Universal Ruler'.

7.2.1.m: The twelve-day rite is both a sacrificial session and an ahīna sacrifice.

7.2.1.d: अपीवानो ऽहीनेन यजेरम्̐स् तान् अदीक्षिता याजयेयुः /
7.2.1.m: If they are drunkards, they should sacrifice with an ahīna sacrifice; non-consecrated [priests] should officiate for them.
There is a fault in officiating for thirteen of them.
With the master of the house as the seventeenth, they are of equal status.
Being themselves the officiating priests, Brahmins should undertake the sacrificial session.
For them, the giving [of sacrificial gifts] and the designation of Varuṇa from the beginning should cease.

7.2.1.s: yāsmin yajña ṛddhiḥ sā naḥ saha \\ ity uktvā gṛhapater agniṣu madhyataḥkāriprabhṛtayo 'gnīn saṃnivapeyuḥ //
7.2.1.d: यास्मिन् यज्ञ ऋद्धिः सा नः सह \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा गृहपतेर् अग्निषु मध्यतःकारिप्रभृतयो ऽग्नीन् संनिवपेयुः //
7.2.1.m: Having said, 'Whatever prosperity is in this sacrifice, may that be ours together,' [the officiating priests] beginning with the madhyataḥkārins should combine their fires into the fires of the master of the house.

7.2.1.s: bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau \\ iti japed yoyo nivaped yeṣāṃ cādhinivapeyuḥ /
7.2.1.d: भवतं नः समनसौ \\ इति जपेद् योयो निवपेद् येषां चाधिनिवपेयुः /
7.2.1.m: Whoever combines, and over whose [fires] they combine, should murmur, 'May you two be of one mind for us.'

7.2.1.s: sāvitrāṇi hutvā vyapādāyāgnīn pṛthag agnihotrāṇi juhuyuḥ /
7.2.1.d: सावित्राणि हुत्वा व्यपादायाग्नीन् पृथग् अग्निहोत्राणि जुहुयुः /
7.2.1.m: Having offered the Sāvitra libations and having separated the fires, they should offer the agnihotras separately.
The procedure is established up to the making of the fire-pan.
They should perform the fumigation and baking on the fires of the master of the house.
Having combined [the fires], they should sacrifice with an animal sacrifice.
So that the bricks are [set up] before the upasads.

7.2.1.s: svakarmāvipratiṣedhe sarveṣām̐ yājamānam ekavad āmnātam ūheta bahuṣu /
7.2.1.d: स्वकर्माविप्रतिषेधे सर्वेषाम्̐ याजमानम् एकवद् आम्नातम् ऊहेत बहुषु /
7.2.1.m: When it does not conflict with one's own duty, one should adapt for many whatever duties of the sacrificer are handed down in the singular for all.

7.2.1.s: evam̐ hotāram̐ vṛtvā sarvān pravṛṇīte / samānagotrān avyavahitān sakṛtsakṛt pratipuruṣam̐ vyavahitān /
7.2.1.d: एवम्̐ होतारम्̐ वृत्वा सर्वान् प्रवृणीते / समानगोत्रान् अव्यवहितान् सकृत्सकृत् प्रतिपुरुषम्̐ व्यवहितान् /
7.2.1.m: Having thus chosen the hotṛ, he chooses all of them: those of the same clan without interruption once each; separated individuals individually.
When it is completed, having separated the fires, they should offer the agnihotras separately.
The procedure is established up to the consecration offering.

7.2.1.s: caitrīpakṣasya saptamyāṃ prāgvam̐śe saṃnyupya dīkṣeran sarve sunvantaḥ /
7.2.1.d: चैत्रीपक्षस्य सप्तम्यां प्राग्वम्̐शे संन्युप्य दीक्षेरन् सर्वे सुन्वन्तः /
7.2.1.m: On the seventh day of the fortnight of Caitra, having combined [the fires] in the east-hall, all of them, pressing [the soma], should be consecrated.
All partake of the sacrificer's share.

7.2.1.s: abhyundanaprabhṛti pāvanāntam ekaikasya gṛhapatimukhān adhvaryur madhyataḥkāriṇo dīkṣayati pratiprasthātā patnīr adhvaryumukhān pratiprasthātārdhino neṣṭā patnīḥ pratiprasthātṛmukhān neṣṭā tṛtīyina unnetā patnīr neṣṭṛmukhān unnetā pādinaḥ sa eva patnīr anyo brāhmaṇa unnetāram /
7.2.1.d: अभ्युन्दनप्रभृति पावनान्तम् एकैकस्य गृहपतिमुखान् अध्वर्युर् मध्यतःकारिणो दीक्षयति प्रतिप्रस्थाता पत्नीर् अध्वर्युमुखान् प्रतिप्रस्थातार्धिनो नेष्टा पत्नीः प्रतिप्रस्थातृमुखान् नेष्टा तृतीयिन उन्नेता पत्नीर् नेष्टृमुखान् उन्नेता पादिनः स एव पत्नीर् अन्यो ब्राह्मण उन्नेतारम् /
7.2.1.m: From the sprinkling to the purification for each, the adhvaryu consecrates the madhyataḥkārins beginning with the master of the house; the pratiprasthātṛ the wives; the pratiprasthātṛ those beginning with the adhvaryu; the neṣṭṛ the wives; the neṣṭṛ the third-share priests beginning with the pratiprasthātṛ; the unnetṛ the wives; the unnetṛ the fourth-share priests beginning with the neṣṭṛ; he also the wives; another Brahmin [consecrates] the unnetṛ.
The ritual act of consecration, beginning with the black antelope skin and ending with covering, is for each individually; the putting on of the fuel sticks is established.

7.2.1.s: rukmapratimocanādi vātsaprāntam ekaikasya muṣṭikaraṇādy āvedanāntam ekaikasya daikṣaṃ karma siddham /
7.2.1.d: रुक्मप्रतिमोचनादि वात्सप्रान्तम् एकैकस्य मुष्टिकरणाद्य् आवेदनान्तम् एकैकस्य दैक्षं कर्म सिद्धम् /
7.2.1.m: The ritual act of consecration beginning with fastening the gold plate and ending with the Vātsapra rite is for each individually; beginning with making fists and ending with the announcement is for each individually; it is established.

7.2.1.s: vratāktām añjyāt sarveṣām̐ vrateṣvahīne bhṛtim̐ vanvīran /
7.2.1.d: व्रताक्ताम् अञ्ज्यात् सर्वेषाम्̐ व्रतेष्वहीने भृतिम्̐ वन्वीरन् /
7.2.1.m: He should anoint [the eyes] with [butter] anointed with the fast-milk; during the fast days of all [in the session], in an ahīna sacrifice they should seek sustenance.
In the case of a sixteen-day rite, a cow with pierced ears is the purchase-cow for King Soma.
On the first [upasad day], having performed [the rites] up to the arrangement [of the fire-altar], they stay overnight.

7.2.1.s: śvobhūte citim anyasminn ahani purīṣam anyasminn ahany ekādaśāyām̐ vikarṣaṇāntaṃ kṛtvā vasanti /
7.2.1.d: श्वोभूते चितिम् अन्यस्मिन्न् अहनि पुरीषम् अन्यस्मिन्न् अहन्य् एकादशायाम्̐ विकर्षणान्तं कृत्वा वसन्ति /
7.2.1.m: On the next day [they lay] a layer; on another day, the earth layer; on another day—on the eleventh—having performed [the rites] up to the raking together, they stay overnight.
On the next day, all are consecrated.
When [the hotṛ] is chosen, they hand the staffs of the consecrated to the Maitrāvaruṇa.
On the next day is the Prāyaṇīya Atirātra.
The procedure is established up to the taking down of King [Soma].
He takes down the twelfth part with another cloth.
The procedure is established up to making it of full body.

7.2.1.s: satanukṛtaṃ pañcadhā vyuduhya prāṇagrahair abhimṛśati \\ ayaṃ puro bhūr iti paryāyaiḥ pratidiśaṃ pañcamena madhye /
7.2.1.d: सतनुकृतं पञ्चधा व्युदुह्य प्राणग्रहैर् अभिमृशति \\ अयं पुरो भूर् इति पर्यायैः प्रतिदिशं पञ्चमेन मध्ये /
7.2.1.m: Having pushed aside into five parts that which is made of full body, he touches it with the prāṇagraha cups with the rounds [beginning with], 'This earth in the front,' in each direction, and with the fifth in the middle.

7.2.1.s: prāyaṇīyodayanīyayor daśame cāhany am̐śvadābhyau prāṇagrahāś ca /
7.2.1.d: प्रायणीयोदयनीययोर् दशमे चाहन्य् अम्̐श्वदाभ्यौ प्राणग्रहाश् च /
7.2.1.m: On the opening and concluding days and on the tenth day, there are the Aṃśu and Adābhya cups and the prāṇagraha cups.

7.2.1.s: aṣṭāv idhmaśakalān ādāyāśrāvam ṛtupraiṣādibhir vṛṇīte yathāmnātam̐ hotāram agnir daivīnām̐ viśāṃ puraeteme sunvanto yajamānā manuṣyāṇām ity ūhena yajamānāḥ /
7.2.1.d: अष्टाव् इध्मशकलान् आदायाश्रावम् ऋतुप्रैषादिभिर् वृणीते यथाम्नातम्̐ होतारम् अग्निर् दैवीनाम्̐ विशां पुरएतेमे सुन्वन्तो यजमाना मनुष्याणाम् इत्य् ऊहेन यजमानाः /
7.2.1.m: Taking eight fuel chips and calling for the śrauṣaṭ recitation, he selects the hotṛ priest as prescribed with the season-calls and so on; the sacrificers [say] with adaptation: “Agni, the leader of the divine subjects; these sacrificers pressing [soma] among men.”
The householder consumes the sacrificer’s soma cup.
The procedure is established up to the time for the sacrificial gifts.

7.2.1.s: dākṣiṇau homau hutvā \\ idam ahaṃ māṃ kalyāṇyai kīrtyai svargāya lokāyāmṛtatvāya dakṣiṇaṃ dadāmi \\ iti dakṣiṇāpathena kṛṣṇājināni dhūnvanto 'harahar āvrajeyuḥ / prāsarpakaṃ ca dadyur hiraṇyam̐ vāso gavām̐ svād anyād ahīne sahasram /
7.2.1.d: दाक्षिणौ होमौ हुत्वा \\ इदम् अहं मां कल्याण्यै कीर्त्यै स्वर्गाय लोकायामृतत्वाय दक्षिणं ददामि \\ इति दक्षिणापथेन कृष्णाजिनानि धून्वन्तो ऽहरहर् आव्रजेयुः / प्रासर्पकं च दद्युर् हिरण्यम्̐ वासो गवाम्̐ स्वाद् अन्याद् अहीने सहस्रम् /
7.2.1.m: Having offered the two oblations for the sacrificial gifts, shaking black antelope skins along the path of the sacrificial gifts, they should approach day by day with: “Here I give myself as a sacrificial gift for fair fame, for the heavenly world, for immortality.” And they should give a creepers’ gift: gold, a garment, cattle from their own property, and in a multi-day soma sacrifice another thousand [cows].
Having divided them into equal portions, they should give them day by day.
On the last day takes place the casting away of the horn and the dismissal of friendship.
At the ends of the pressings they creep out.
Before the yajñāyajñīya [sāman] he draws the vasatīvarī waters.

7.2.1.s: atipreṣita agnīdhraḥ svasya dhiṣṇyasya paścāt sadyaḥsutyām indrāgnibhyāṃ prabravīmi mitrāvaruṇābhyām̐ viśvebhyo devebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ somyebhyaḥ somapebhyo \ brahman vācam̐ yacha \\ ity āvedayati /
7.2.1.d: अतिप्रेषित अग्नीध्रः स्वस्य धिष्ण्यस्य पश्चात् सद्यःसुत्याम् इन्द्राग्निभ्यां प्रब्रवीमि मित्रावरुणाभ्याम्̐ विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सोम्येभ्यः सोमपेभ्यो \ ब्रह्मन् वाचम्̐ यछ \\ इत्य् आवेदयति /
7.2.1.m: Prompted by the higher call, the āgnīdhra, behind his own dhiṣṇya hearth, announces: “I proclaim the same-day pressing to Indra-and-Agni, to Mitra-and-Varuṇa, to the Viśve Devas, to the brāhmaṇas who are worthy of soma, who drink soma. O brahman, restrain your speech!”
The days conclude with the patnīsaṃyājas.

7.2.1.s: ayāś cāgne 'si \\ iti sarvaprāyaścittaṃ hutvā samidha ādadhāti /
7.2.1.d: अयाश् चाग्ने ऽसि \\ इति सर्वप्रायश्चित्तं हुत्वा समिध आदधाति /
7.2.1.m: Having offered the all-expiation [libation] with: “And you, O Agni, are ayās…”, he places fuel sticks on the fire.

7.2.1.s: idhmābarhiḥ saṃnahya parihṛtāsu vasatīvarīṣu vācam̐ visṛjante /
7.2.1.d: इध्माबर्हिः संनह्य परिहृतासु वसतीवरीषु वाचम्̐ विसृजन्ते /
7.2.1.m: Having tied up the sacrificial fuel and grass, once the vasatīvarī waters have been carried around, they release their speech.

7.2.2.m: Day after day, the pṛṣṭhya six-day period is performed.
Its [first day] is an agniṣṭoma having the trivṛt stoma, performed on the same day, with the Rathaṃtara as its sāman.
[The procedure] up to the bahiṣpavamāna hymn is established.
On the opening and concluding [days] they chant outside; on the other [days], in the sadas.
With the sound of a chariot, with two blades of darbha grass, he brings near the stotra for the Mahendra [cup].
Everywhere at the pṛṣṭhya-śilpa rites, two blades of darbha grass [are used].
